scope: Original bilingual local educational computing, privacy and scientific-system analysis. Synthetic or authorized data only; no real-target attack or production configuration.

courses.title: 軟體弱點管理流程
courses.summary: 以弱點風險、相依圖與修補放行串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
courses.summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect vulnerability risk, dependency graphs and patch acceptance with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.

stages.title: 資產與風險
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「資產與風險」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop assets and risk through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 資產識別：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「資產識別」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for asset identity.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「資產識別」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：同一主機的版本、角色與責任人須以穩定識別串連。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「以合成清單找出重複名稱與缺漏責任人。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for asset identity. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Stable identifiers connect version, role and accountable owner. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Find duplicate names and missing owners in a synthetic inventory. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 以合成清單找出重複名稱與缺漏責任人。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Find duplicate names and missing owners in a synthetic inventory. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：主機名稱相同便必然是同一資產。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Equal hostnames necessarily mean equal assets. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「資產識別」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「以合成清單找出重複名稱與缺漏責任人。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for asset identity; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 同一主機的版本、角色與責任人須以穩定識別串連。
knowledge.textEn: Stable identifiers connect version, role and accountable owner.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 以合成清單找出重複名稱與缺漏責任人。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Find duplicate names and missing owners in a synthetic inventory. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 假想 200 個受影響資產中完成 170 個，覆蓋率為 85%；若另有 10 個盤點遺漏資產，真正分母為 210，覆蓋率降至 80.95%。覆蓋不是風險消除率，例子不使用實際弱點或目標。
knowledge.textEn: In a synthetic inventory, 170 of 200 affected assets gives 85% coverage. Ten missing assets change the denominator to 210 and coverage to 80.95%. Coverage is not risk-elimination probability; no real vulnerability or target is used.

quiz.question: 審查「資產識別」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for asset identity?
options: 主機名稱相同便必然是同一資產。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「資產識別」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
同一主機的版本、角色與責任人須以穩定識別串連。
optionsEn: Equal hostnames necessarily mean equal assets.
One matching output proves asset identity for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
Stable identifiers connect version, role and accountable owner.
quiz.explanation: 同一主機的版本、角色與責任人須以穩定識別串連。 以合成清單找出重複名稱與缺漏責任人。 因此「主機名稱相同便必然是同一資產。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Stable identifiers connect version, role and accountable owner. Find duplicate names and missing owners in a synthetic inventory. The alternative "Equal hostnames necessarily mean equal assets." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 資產識別：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「資產識別」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for asset identity.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「以合成清單找出重複名稱與缺漏責任人。」；將結果與「同一主機的版本、角色與責任人須以穩定識別串連。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Find duplicate names and missing owners in a synthetic inventory. Compare results against: Stable identifiers connect version, role and accountable owner. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 以合成清單找出重複名稱與缺漏責任人。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Equal hostnames necessarily mean equal assets. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「資產識別」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「主機名稱相同便必然是同一資產。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for asset identity; explain why this claim fails: Equal hostnames necessarily mean equal assets.

quiz.questionEn: Which validation approach is justified for asset identity?

steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「在本地假想網路圖分開外部、內部及離線資產。」；將結果與「可達性與許可權前提會改變同一弱點的情境風險。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Separate external, internal and offline assets on a local diagram. Compare results against: Reachability and privilege prerequisites change contextual risk. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 在本地假想網路圖分開外部、內部及離線資產。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Separate external, internal and offline assets on a local diagram. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：分數相同的弱點都有相同營運風險。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Equal scores imply equal operational risk. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「暴露面」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「分數相同的弱點都有相同營運風險。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for exposure surface; explain why this claim fails: Equal scores imply equal operational risk.

quiz.question: 審查「暴露面」的驗證方法時，哪個說法成立？

options: 分數相同的弱點都有相同營運風險。
在本地假想網路圖分開外部、內部及離線資產。
先把「暴露面」的顯示結果調到符合預期，再把這次吻合當作獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Equal scores imply equal operational risk.
Separate external, internal and offline assets on a local diagram.
Tune the displayed exposure surface result to the expected value and count that agreement as independent validation.

steps.title: 優先序：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「優先序」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for prioritization.

steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for prioritization. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Evidence, criticality and compensating controls jointly inform priority. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Rank anonymous equal-score cases with different exposure. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 用匿名情境比較同分不同暴露面的排序。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Rank anonymous equal-score cases with different exposure. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: All low-score items can be ignored permanently. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「優先序」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「用匿名情境比較同分不同暴露面的排序。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for prioritization; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

quiz.question: 審查「版本相依」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for version dependencies?
options: 修補一個元件可能使相依介面不相容。
安全更新不可能改變功能介面。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「版本相依」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: Patching one component may break dependent interfaces.
Security updates cannot change interfaces.
One matching output proves version dependencies for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
quiz.explanation: 修補一個元件可能使相依介面不相容。 將假想 API 版本變更傳播到相依圖。 因此「安全更新不可能改變功能介面。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。

steps.title: 版本相依：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「版本相依」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for version dependencies.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「將假想 API 版本變更傳播到相依圖。」；將結果與「修補一個元件可能使相依介面不相容。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Propagate a synthetic API change through dependencies. Compare results against: Patching one component may break dependent interfaces. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 將假想 API 版本變更傳播到相依圖。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Propagate a synthetic API change through dependencies. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：安全更新不可能改變功能介面。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Security updates cannot change interfaces. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「版本相依」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「安全更新不可能改變功能介面。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for version dependencies; explain why this claim fails: Security updates cannot change interfaces.

steps.title: 變更視窗：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「變更視窗」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for change windows.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「變更視窗」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：可用性與風險會共同約束部署時間。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「比較有備援與單節點的停機預算。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for change windows. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Availability and risk jointly constrain deployment timing. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare downtime budgets with and without redundancy. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 比較有備援與單節點的停機預算。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。

steps.failure: 常見誤判：最短部署時間必然最安全。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: The shortest deployment is necessarily safest. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「變更視窗」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「比較有備援與單節點的停機預算。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for change windows; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「測試與部署」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop testing and deployment through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 測試矩陣：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「測試矩陣」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for test matrix.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「測試矩陣」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：安全、功能與負載回歸應各有可觀測條件。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「在玩具服務列出三類測試與預期輸出。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。

Principle: Security, functional and load regression need separate criteria. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: List three test classes and expected outputs for a toy service. steps.observation: 在離線相依圖預測隔離對業務的影響。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Predict isolation impact on an offline dependency graph. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：隔離越多裝置業務損失必然越小。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: More isolation necessarily reduces business loss. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.

steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for containment cost; explain why this claim fails: More isolation necessarily reduces business loss.

steps.title: 證據與復原：原理與架構
steps.titleEn: Evidence and recovery: principles and architecture
steps.objective: 以「證據與復原」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for evidence and recovery.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「證據與復原」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：急速復原可能改寫尚未儲存的證據。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「比較先取樣與先重啟的資料保留情境。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for evidence and recovery. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Rapid recovery can overwrite unpreserved evidence. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare sampling-first and restart-first evidence retention. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 比較先取樣與先重啟的資料保留情境。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Compare sampling-first and restart-first evidence retention. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：重新啟動不可能影響可用證據。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Restarting cannot affect available evidence. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「證據與復原」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「比較先取樣與先重啟的資料保留情境。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for evidence and recovery; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 急速復原可能改寫尚未儲存的證據。
knowledge.textEn: Rapid recovery can overwrite unpreserved evidence.

knowledge.textEn: Compare sampling-first and restart-first evidence retention. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for evidence and recovery?
options: 急速復原可能改寫尚未儲存的證據。
重新啟動不可能影響可用證據。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「證據與復原」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: Rapid recovery can overwrite unpreserved evidence.
Restarting cannot affect available evidence.
One matching output proves evidence and recovery for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.

knowledge.textEn: Compare functional, data and security acceptance offline. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

quiz.question: 審查「復原驗證」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for recovery validation?
options: HTTP 成功狀態即可結案。
能回應請求不能證明資料正確及風險解除。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「復原驗證」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: An HTTP success status closes the incident.
Serving requests does not prove correct data or removed risk.
One matching output proves recovery validation for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
quiz.explanation: 能回應請求不能證明資料正確及風險解除。 比較功能、資料與安全三類離線驗收。 因此「HTTP 成功狀態即可結案。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Serving requests does not prove correct data or removed risk. Compare functional, data and security acceptance offline. The alternative "An HTTP success status closes the incident." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 復原驗證：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「復原驗證」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for recovery validation.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「比較功能、資料與安全三類離線驗收。」；將結果與「能回應請求不能證明資料正確及風險解除。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Compare functional, data and security acceptance offline. Compare results against: Serving requests does not prove correct data or removed risk. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 比較功能、資料與安全三類離線驗收。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Compare functional, data and security acceptance offline. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：HTTP 成功狀態即可結案。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: An HTTP success status closes the incident. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「復原驗證」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「HTTP 成功狀態即可結案。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for recovery validation; explain why this claim fails: An HTTP success status closes the incident.

options: HTTP 成功狀態即可結案。

stages.title: 學習與驗收
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「學習與驗收」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop learning and acceptance through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 通知紀錄：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「通知紀錄」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for communication records.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「通知紀錄」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：通知應依已確認事實、時點與責任角色。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「撰寫匿名演練摘要並標示未證實項。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for communication records. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Communication follows confirmed facts, timing and accountable roles. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Write an anonymous exercise brief with unconfirmed items marked. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 撰寫匿名演練摘要並標示未證實項。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Write an anonymous exercise brief with unconfirmed items marked. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：未確認推測可直接當作正式事件結論。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Unconfirmed speculation can be a formal conclusion. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「通知紀錄」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「撰寫匿名演練摘要並標示未證實項。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for communication records; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

steps.objective: 以「偵測指標」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。

steps.title: 唯讀路徑：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「唯讀路徑」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。

steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for read-only paths. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Write blocking covers the entire collection path. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare read-only settings and writes on local copies only. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.title: 採集吞吐：原理與架構

Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Read/write bottlenecks and verification passes set duration. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Recalculate collection and verification time bounds. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Rated disk bandwidth equals end-to-end collection speed. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「採集吞吐」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「重算本課映像採集與驗證下限。」如何辨別它們。

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 假想 100 人平均收入分析先將收入界定於 0–100,000 單位；固定樣本數替換鄰接下，平均敏感度 Δ=100000/100=1000 單位。Laplace ε=1 時尺度 b=1000、標準差 √2b=1414.21 單位。只此假設成立時適用。
knowledge.textEn: For 100 synthetic people with values bounded to 0–100,000 units and fixed-size replace-one adjacency, mean sensitivity is 1,000 units. Laplace ε=1 gives b=1,000 and standard deviation 1,414.21 units; the assumptions are essential.

steps.objective: 以「用途邊界」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for purpose boundaries.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「寫出合成資料分析的必要與非必要用途。」；將結果與「同一資料可因使用目的不同而形成不同隱私風險。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Specify necessary and unnecessary uses of synthetic data. Compare results against: The same data creates different privacy risks under different purposes. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 寫出合成資料分析的必要與非必要用途。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Specify necessary and unnecessary uses of synthetic data. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：取得一次同意便能用於任何新目的。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: One consent permits every future purpose. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「用途邊界」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「取得一次同意便能用於任何新目的。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for purpose boundaries; explain why this claim fails: One consent permits every future purpose.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 同一資料可因使用目的不同而形成不同隱私風險。
knowledge.textEn: The same data creates different privacy risks under different purposes.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 寫出合成資料分析的必要與非必要用途。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Specify necessary and unnecessary uses of synthetic data. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 假想 100 人平均收入分析先將收入界定於 0–100,000 單位；固定樣本數替換鄰接下，平均敏感度 Δ=100000/100=1000 單位。Laplace ε=1 時尺度 b=1000、標準差 √2b=1414.21 單位。只此假設成立時適用。
knowledge.textEn: For 100 synthetic people with values bounded to 0–100,000 units and fixed-size replace-one adjacency, mean sensitivity is 1,000 units. Laplace ε=1 gives b=1,000 and standard deviation 1,414.21 units; the assumptions are essential.

quiz.question: 審查「用途邊界」的驗證方法時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which validation approach is justified for purpose boundaries?
options: 寫出合成資料分析的必要與非必要用途。
取得一次同意便能用於任何新目的。
先把「用途邊界」的顯示結果調到符合預期，再把這次吻合當作獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Specify necessary and unnecessary uses of synthetic data.
One consent permits every future purpose.
Tune the displayed purpose boundaries result to the expected value and count that agreement as independent validation.
quiz.explanation: 同一資料可因使用目的不同而形成不同隱私風險。 寫出合成資料分析的必要與非必要用途。 因此「取得一次同意便能用於任何新目的。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: The same data creates different privacy risks under different purposes. Specify necessary and unnecessary uses of synthetic data. The alternative "One consent permits every future purpose." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 資料最小化：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「資料最小化」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for data minimization.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「資料最小化」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：少收欄位能降低暴露但可能降低可辨識性。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「比較完整與最小化欄位的合成模型誤差。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for data minimization. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Fewer fields reduce exposure but can reduce identifiability of effects. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare synthetic-model errors with full and minimal fields. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 比較完整與最小化欄位的合成模型誤差。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Compare synthetic-model errors with full and minimal fields. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：刪除姓名即完成最小化。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Deleting names completes minimization. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「資料最小化」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「比較完整與最小化欄位的合成模型誤差。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for data minimization; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for data minimization?
options: 刪除姓名即完成最小化。
少收欄位能降低暴露但可能降低可辨識性。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「資料最小化」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: Deleting names completes minimization.
Fewer fields reduce exposure but can reduce identifiability of effects.
One matching output proves data minimization for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.

knowledge.textEn: Mark fields visible at each layer of an anonymous architecture. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

quiz.question: 審查「信任邊界」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for trust boundaries?
options: 所有參與者都必須看原始資料。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「信任邊界」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
蒐集者、分析者與發布者可有不同許可權。
optionsEn: Every participant must see raw data.
One matching output proves trust boundaries for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
Collectors, analysts and publishers can have different privileges.
quiz.explanation: 蒐集者、分析者與發布者可有不同許可權。 標示匿名架構每一層可見的欄位。 因此「所有參與者都必須看原始資料。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Collectors, analysts and publishers can have different privileges. Mark fields visible at each layer of an anonymous architecture. The alternative "Every participant must see raw data." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 信任邊界：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「信任邊界」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for trust boundaries.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「標示匿名架構每一層可見的欄位。」；將結果與「蒐集者、分析者與發布者可有不同許可權。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Mark fields visible at each layer of an anonymous architecture. Compare results against: Collectors, analysts and publishers can have different privileges. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 標示匿名架構每一層可見的欄位。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Mark fields visible at each layer of an anonymous architecture. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有參與者都必須看原始資料。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Every participant must see raw data. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「信任邊界」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「所有參與者都必須看原始資料。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for trust boundaries; explain why this claim fails: Every participant must see raw data.

stages.title: 風險與模型
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「風險與模型」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop risk and models through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 威脅模型：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「威脅模型」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for threat models.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「威脅模型」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：保護方法依攻擊者先驗知識與可見輸出而異。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「在紙上設定兩種先驗而不使用真實個資。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for threat models. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Protection depends on adversary knowledge and visible outputs. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Specify two priors on paper without real personal data. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 在紙上設定兩種先驗而不使用真實個資。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Specify two priors on paper without real personal data. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：保護強度完全與外部知識無關。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Protection is independent of outside knowledge. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「威脅模型」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「在紙上設定兩種先驗而不使用真實個資。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for threat models; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

stages.title: 驗證與治理
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「驗證與治理」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop verification and governance through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 偏差檢查：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「偏差檢查」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for bias checks.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「偏差檢查」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：總體效用可能掩蓋少數群組的不良誤差。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「以合成群組另列誤差與缺測率。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。

State an observable prediction before planning this check: Report synthetic-group errors and missingness separately. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.title: 偏差檢查：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「偏差檢查」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for bias checks.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「以合成群組另列誤差與缺測率。」；將結果與「總體效用可能掩蓋少數群組的不良誤差。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。

stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop gradients and aggregation through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 樣本權重：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「樣本權重」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for sample weights.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「樣本權重」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：FedAvg 樣本權重與客戶等權有不同目標。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「重算本課三客戶兩種聚合。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。

Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Recalculate both aggregation choices for three clients. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for sample weights; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

steps.title: 樣本權重：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「樣本權重」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。

steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「重算本課三客戶兩種聚合。」；將結果與「FedAvg 樣本權重與客戶等權有不同目標。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。

Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.

steps.check: 提交「樣本權重」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「等權與樣本加權永遠相等。」為何不成立。

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 發布模型需連結參與政策與隱私會計紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: Released models link participation policies and privacy accounting.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 產生無個資的玩具模型卡與設定摘要。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Create a personal-data-free toy model card and settings digest. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 假想三個客戶分別有 20、30、50 筆資料與標量更新 1、3、5；FedAvg 權重為 0.2、0.3、0.5，聚合更新為 3.6。等權平均為 3；權重差異反映樣本數而非品質保證，也未提供隱私保證。

Final weights suffice to audit federated training.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Final weights suffice to audit federated training. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「交付版本」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「保留最終權重便足以稽核聯邦訓練。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for delivery versions; explain why this claim fails: Final weights suffice to audit federated training.

courses.scope: 公開原理的本地科教模擬與工程判讀。只使用自製、合成或明確授權的資料；不操作真實受害主機、他人帳號、工業控制或超算設施。數值不代表廠商規格或實測效能，完成課程不是專業資格、真實裝置操作經歷或生產部署認證。
courses.scopeEn: Local educational simulation and engineering interpretation of public principles. Use self-made, synthetic or explicitly licensed data only; do not operate real victim hosts, other accounts, industrial control or supercomputing facilities. Values are not product specifications or measured performance. Completion is not a qualification, real-equipment experience or production-deployment certification.

workedExample.assumptions: 使用算例明列的單位、分佈、精度、拓撲與理想化條件；改變鄰接、位寬、取樣或系統邊界必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated units, distributions, precision, topology and idealizations; recompute after changing adjacency, width, sampling or boundaries.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者獨立設定的假想數值例，非引用機構的實測資料；來源支援領域定義與架構。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical values, not institutional measurements; sources support definitions and architecture.

courses.title: 差分隱私查詢服務
courses.summary: 以鄰接定義、敏感度與查詢預算串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
courses.summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect adjacency, sensitivity and query budgets with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.

stages.title: 隱私定義
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「隱私定義」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop privacy definitions through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 保護單位：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「保護單位」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。

steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「保護單位」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：一筆紀錄與一位使用者可能不是同一鄰接單位。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「比較每人一筆與每人多筆的敏感度。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。

Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: A record and a person may be different adjacency units. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare sensitivity with one versus many records per person. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.check: 提交「保護單位」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「比較每人一筆與每人多筆的敏感度。」如何辨別它們。

stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「機制與效用」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop mechanisms and utility through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 敏感度界限：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「敏感度界限」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for sensitivity bounds.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「敏感度界限」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：剪裁或取值界限須在看到私密極值前固定。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「比較預先有界與依資料最大值設定的方法。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for sensitivity bounds. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Bounds are fixed before using private extremes. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare predetermined bounds with data-derived maxima. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 比較預先有界與依資料最大值設定的方法。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Compare predetermined bounds with data-derived maxima. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：直接取私密最大值定界永不消耗隱私。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Private maxima can define bounds without privacy cost. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「敏感度界限」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「比較預先有界與依資料最大值設定的方法。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for sensitivity bounds; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 剪裁或取值界限須在看到私密極值前固定。
knowledge.textEn: Bounds are fixed before using private extremes.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 比較預先有界與依資料最大值設定的方法。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Compare predetermined bounds with data-derived maxima. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

quiz.question: 審查「敏感度界限」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for sensitivity bounds?
options: 剪裁或取值界限須在看到私密極值前固定。
直接取私密最大值定界永不消耗隱私。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「敏感度界限」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: Bounds are fixed before using private extremes.
Private maxima can define bounds without privacy cost.
One matching output proves sensitivity bounds for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
quiz.explanation: 剪裁或取值界限須在看到私密極值前固定。 比較預先有界與依資料最大值設定的方法。 因此「直接取私密最大值定界永不消耗隱私。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Bounds are fixed before using private extremes. Compare predetermined bounds with data-derived maxima. The alternative "Private maxima can define bounds without privacy cost." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 敏感度界限：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「敏感度界限」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for sensitivity bounds.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「比較預先有界與依資料最大值設定的方法。」；將結果與「剪裁或取值界限須在看到私密極值前固定。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Compare predetermined bounds with data-derived maxima. Compare results against: Bounds are fixed before using private extremes. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 比較預先有界與依資料最大值設定的方法。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Compare predetermined bounds with data-derived maxima. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：直接取私密最大值定界永不消耗隱私。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Private maxima can define bounds without privacy cost. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「敏感度界限」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「直接取私密最大值定界永不消耗隱私。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for sensitivity bounds; explain why this claim fails: Private maxima can define bounds without privacy cost.

quiz.question: 審查「敏感度界限」的驗證方法時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which validation approach is justified for sensitivity bounds?
options: 直接取私密最大值定界永不消耗隱私。
比較預先有界與依資料最大值設定的方法。
先把「敏感度界限」的顯示結果調到符合預期，再把這次吻合當作獨立驗證。

steps.title: Laplace 機制：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「Laplace 機制」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for laplace mechanism.

steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for laplace mechanism. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Count-noise scale is L1 sensitivity divided by epsilon. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Recalculate scale and standard deviation for different epsilon. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 重算本課尺度、標準差及不同 ε。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Recalculate scale and standard deviation for different epsilon. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Noise scale equals epsilon times sensitivity. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「Laplace 機制」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「重算本課尺度、標準差及不同 ε。」如何辨別它們。

Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Draw data owner, evaluator and result recipient. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.check: 提交「明密文邊界」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「畫資料持有者、運算者及結果接收者。」如何辨別它們。

Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

quiz.explanationEn: Encrypted processing does not prevent sensitive result disclosure. Compare full prediction vectors with aggregate-output needs. The alternative "HE eliminates output-privacy controls." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

courses.scope: 公開原理的本地科教模擬與工程判讀。只使用自製、合成或明確授權的資料；不操作真實受害主機、他人帳號、工業控制或超算設施。數值不代表廠商規格或實測效能，完成課程不是專業資格、真實裝置操作經歷或生產部署認證。
courses.scopeEn: Local educational simulation and engineering interpretation of public principles. Use self-made, synthetic or explicitly licensed data only; do not operate real victim hosts, other accounts, industrial control or supercomputing facilities. Values are not product specifications or measured performance. Completion is not a qualification, real-equipment experience or production-deployment certification.

workedExample.title: 含假設的可重算工程例
workedExample.text: 玩具模環 Z₁₇ 的明文 8+12≡3 (mod17)，8×12≡11。若欲表達一般整數 20，模數 17 會迴繞；這只是明文算術，不是安全加密參數或密文安全實作。

workedExample.assumptions: 使用算例明列的單位、分佈、精度、拓撲與理想化條件；改變鄰接、位寬、取樣或系統邊界必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated units, distributions, precision, topology and idealizations; recompute after changing adjacency, width, sampling or boundaries.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者獨立設定的假想數值例，非引用機構的實測資料；來源支援領域定義與架構。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical values, not institutional measurements; sources support definitions and architecture.

courses.title: 安全多方計算系統
courses.summary: 以秘密分享、協議威脅模型與通訊成本串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
courses.summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect secret sharing, protocol threat models and communication with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.

stages.title: 參與與威脅
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「參與與威脅」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop parties and threats through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 參與方角色：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「參與方角色」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。

State an observable prediction before planning this check: Mark assumed-honest groups in a three-party toy computation. knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 玩具模環 Z₁₇ 將秘密 s=9 分享為 4、7、15，因為 (4+7+15) mod17=9。每個分享若按正確隨機協議產生可隱藏原值；此固定例子不構成安全實作。加上公開值 3 後可只改一個分享為 7，和變為 12。

knowledge.textEn: Recalculate the three shares and modular reduction. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

quiz.question: 審查「分享代數」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for sharing algebra?
options: 直接做一般整數加法便是環重建。
加法分享的總和在指定有限環重建秘密。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「分享代數」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: Ordinary integer addition alone reconstructs ring secrets.
Additive shares reconstruct by summing in a specified finite ring.
One matching output proves sharing algebra for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
quiz.explanation: 加法分享的總和在指定有限環重建秘密。 重算本課三個分享及模數折返。 因此「直接做一般整數加法便是環重建。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Additive shares reconstruct by summing in a specified finite ring. Recalculate the three shares and modular reduction. The alternative "Ordinary integer addition alone reconstructs ring secrets." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 分享代數：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「分享代數」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for sharing algebra.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「重算本課三個分享及模數折返。」；將結果與「加法分享的總和在指定有限環重建秘密。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Recalculate the three shares and modular reduction. Compare results against: Additive shares reconstruct by summing in a specified finite ring. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 重算本課三個分享及模數折返。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Recalculate the three shares and modular reduction. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：直接做一般整數加法便是環重建。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Ordinary integer addition alone reconstructs ring secrets. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「分享代數」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「直接做一般整數加法便是環重建。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for sharing algebra; explain why this claim fails: Ordinary integer addition alone reconstructs ring secrets.

先把「分享代數」的顯示結果調到符合預期，再把這次吻合當作獨立驗證。

steps.title: 隨機性要求：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「隨機性要求」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for randomness requirements.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「隨機性要求」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：分享隱私依賴足夠隨機且不重複的隨機量。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「僅以符號分析重用隨機量可能帶來的關聯。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for randomness requirements. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Share privacy needs adequate, unreused randomness. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Analyze reused-randomness correlations symbolically. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 僅以符號分析重用隨機量可能帶來的關聯。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Analyze reused-randomness correlations symbolically. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：固定教學分享可直接用於保密生產資料。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Fixed teaching shares securely protect production data. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「隨機性要求」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「僅以符號分析重用隨機量可能帶來的關聯。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for randomness requirements; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

stages.title: 分享與運算
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「分享與運算」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop sharing and computation through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 公開加法：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「公開加法」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for public addition.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「公開加法」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：公開常數加到一個加法分享即可調整總秘密。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「比較只加一次與每個分享都加常數。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。

Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Adding a public constant to one additive share changes the secret. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare adding once versus adding to every share. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Adding c to every share adds only c overall. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「公開加法」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「比較只加一次與每個分享都加常數。」如何辨別它們。

State an observable prediction before planning this check: Add toy share vectors by party and verify reconstruction. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

State an observable prediction before planning this check: Draw a toy maximum circuit without revealing intermediate comparisons. courses.title: 圖形資料庫知識網路
courses.summary: 以關係資料、路徑查詢與圖形一致性串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
courses.summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect relationship data, path queries and graph consistency with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.

stages.title: 資料與語意
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「資料與語意」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop data and semantics through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 節點身分：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「節點身分」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for node identity.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「節點身分」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：實體識別與顯示名稱應分開儲存。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「在玩具資料中區分同名人物與同一人物別名。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for node identity. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Entity identity is stored separately from display names. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Separate namesakes and aliases in toy data. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 在玩具資料中區分同名人物與同一人物別名。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Separate namesakes and aliases in toy data. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：顯示名稱相等就能合併節點。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Equal display names justify merging nodes. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「節點身分」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「在玩具資料中區分同名人物與同一人物別名。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for node identity; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 實體識別與顯示名稱應分開儲存。
knowledge.textEn: Entity identity is stored separately from display names.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 在玩具資料中區分同名人物與同一人物別名。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Separate namesakes and aliases in toy data. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 假想平均出度 b=4 的無重複樹狀圖，深度 3 搜尋最多檢查 1+4+16+64=85 個節點。實際圖含環、共享節點與過濾，因此此幾何級數只是展開上界模型，不能當作資料庫耗時預測。
knowledge.textEn: A synthetic tree with branching factor 4 searched to depth 3 visits 1+4+16+64=85 nodes. Real graphs have cycles, shared nodes and filters; this geometric model is not a database runtime prediction.

quiz.question: 審查「節點身分」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for node identity?
options: 顯示名稱相等就能合併節點。
實體識別與顯示名稱應分開儲存。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「節點身分」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: Equal display names justify merging nodes.
Entity identity is stored separately from display names.
One matching output proves node identity for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
quiz.explanation: 實體識別與顯示名稱應分開儲存。 在玩具資料中區分同名人物與同一人物別名。 因此「顯示名稱相等就能合併節點。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Entity identity is stored separately from display names. Separate namesakes and aliases in toy data. The alternative "Equal display names justify merging nodes." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 節點身分：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「節點身分」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for node identity.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「在玩具資料中區分同名人物與同一人物別名。」；將結果與「實體識別與顯示名稱應分開儲存。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Separate namesakes and aliases in toy data. Compare results against: Entity identity is stored separately from display names. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 在玩具資料中區分同名人物與同一人物別名。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Separate namesakes and aliases in toy data. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：顯示名稱相等就能合併節點。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Equal display names justify merging nodes. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「節點身分」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「顯示名稱相等就能合併節點。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for node identity; explain why this claim fails: Equal display names justify merging nodes.

Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Weights and directions define what shortest means. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare minimum hops and minimum weight on toy paths. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.check: 提交「最短路徑」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「比較最少跳數與最小權重的玩具路徑。」如何辨別它們。

State an observable prediction before planning this check: Locate amplified misestimates in a fictional PROFILE table. steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for update provenance.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「更新溯源」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：刪除或替換關係需保留變更原因和版本。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「比較兩個合成版本的關係差異。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for update provenance. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Deleting or replacing relations retains reason and version. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare relationship differences across synthetic versions. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 比較兩個合成版本的關係差異。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Compare relationship differences across synthetic versions. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：新增邊無需檢查舊知識是否矛盾。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: New edges need no contradiction checks. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「更新溯源」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「比較兩個合成版本的關係差異。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for update provenance; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 刪除或替換關係需保留變更原因和版本。
knowledge.textEn: Deleting or replacing relations retains reason and version.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 比較兩個合成版本的關係差異。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Compare relationship differences across synthetic versions. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

quiz.question: 審查「更新溯源」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for update provenance?
options: 新增邊無需檢查舊知識是否矛盾。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「更新溯源」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
刪除或替換關係需保留變更原因和版本。
optionsEn: New edges need no contradiction checks.
One matching output proves update provenance for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
Deleting or replacing relations retains reason and version.
quiz.explanation: 刪除或替換關係需保留變更原因和版本。 比較兩個合成版本的關係差異。 因此「新增邊無需檢查舊知識是否矛盾。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Deleting or replacing relations retains reason and version. Compare relationship differences across synthetic versions. The alternative "New edges need no contradiction checks." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 更新溯源：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「更新溯源」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for update provenance.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「比較兩個合成版本的關係差異。」；將結果與「刪除或替換關係需保留變更原因和版本。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Compare relationship differences across synthetic versions. Compare results against: Deleting or replacing relations retains reason and version. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 比較兩個合成版本的關係差異。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Compare relationship differences across synthetic versions. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：新增邊無需檢查舊知識是否矛盾。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: New edges need no contradiction checks. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「更新溯源」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「新增邊無需檢查舊知識是否矛盾。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for update provenance; explain why this claim fails: New edges need no contradiction checks.

quiz.questionEn: Which validation approach is justified for update provenance?

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 假想平均出度 b=4 的無重複樹狀圖，深度 3 搜尋最多檢查 1+4+16+64=85 個節點。實際圖含環、共享節點與過濾，因此此幾何級數只是展開上界模型，不能當作資料庫耗時預測。
knowledge.textEn: A synthetic tree with branching factor 4 searched to depth 3 visits 1+4+16+64=85 nodes. Real graphs have cycles, shared nodes and filters; this geometric model is not a database runtime prediction.

courses.scope: 公開原理的本地科教模擬與工程判讀。只使用自製、合成或明確授權的資料；不操作真實受害主機、他人帳號、工業控制或超算設施。數值不代表廠商規格或實測效能，完成課程不是專業資格、真實裝置操作經歷或生產部署認證。
courses.scopeEn: Local educational simulation and engineering interpretation of public principles. Use self-made, synthetic or explicitly licensed data only; do not operate real victim hosts, other accounts, industrial control or supercomputing facilities. Values are not product specifications or measured performance. Completion is not a qualification, real-equipment experience or production-deployment certification.

workedExample.title: 含假設的可重算工程例
workedExample.text: 假想平均出度 b=4 的無重複樹狀圖，深度 3 搜尋最多檢查 1+4+16+64=85 個節點。實際圖含環、共享節點與過濾，因此此幾何級數只是展開上界模型，不能當作資料庫耗時預測。
workedExample.textEn: A synthetic tree with branching factor 4 searched to depth 3 visits 1+4+16+64=85 nodes. Real graphs have cycles, shared nodes and filters; this geometric model is not a database runtime prediction.
workedExample.assumptions: 使用算例明列的單位、分佈、精度、拓撲與理想化條件；改變鄰接、位寬、取樣或系統邊界必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated units, distributions, precision, topology and idealizations; recompute after changing adjacency, width, sampling or boundaries.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者獨立設定的假想數值例，非引用機構的實測資料；來源支援領域定義與架構。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical values, not institutional measurements; sources support definitions and architecture.

courses.title: 搜尋引擎索引與排序
courses.summary: 以倒排索引、詞項評分與搜尋品質串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
courses.summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect inverted indexes, term scoring and search quality with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.

stages.title: 文字與索引
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「文字與索引」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop text and indexes through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 檔案身分：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「檔案身分」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for document identity.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「檔案身分」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：索引檔案需穩定 ID、版本和來源。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「把三個自製檔案的更新映到索引 ID。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for document identity. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Indexed documents need stable IDs, versions and origins. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Map updates of three self-made documents to index IDs. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 把三個自製檔案的更新映到索引 ID。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Map updates of three self-made documents to index IDs. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: An unchanged URL implies unchanged content. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「檔案身分」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「把三個自製檔案的更新映到索引 ID。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for document identity; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.textEn: For N=1,000 and n=100, BM25 IDF is 2.2986. With tf=3, k1=1.2, b=0.75 and average-length text, the term score is about 3.6121; it is not a relevance probability.

State an observable prediction before planning this check: Calculate relative changes for tf 1,3 and 10. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.objective: 以「長度正規化」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。

steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「比較相同 tf 的短文與長文。」；將結果與「長檔案的詞頻需依相對長度調整。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。

courses.scope: 公開原理的本地科教模擬與工程判讀。只使用自製、合成或明確授權的資料；不操作真實受害主機、他人帳號、工業控制或超算設施。數值不代表廠商規格或實測效能，完成課程不是專業資格、真實裝置操作經歷或生產部署認證。
courses.scopeEn: Local educational simulation and engineering interpretation of public principles. Use self-made, synthetic or explicitly licensed data only; do not operate real victim hosts, other accounts, industrial control or supercomputing facilities. Values are not product specifications or measured performance. Completion is not a qualification, real-equipment experience or production-deployment certification.

workedExample.title: 含假設的可重算工程例
workedExample.textEn: For N=1,000 and n=100, BM25 IDF is 2.2986. With tf=3, k1=1.2, b=0.75 and average-length text, the term score is about 3.6121; it is not a relevance probability.
workedExample.assumptions: 使用算例明列的單位、分佈、精度、拓撲與理想化條件；改變鄰接、位寬、取樣或系統邊界必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated units, distributions, precision, topology and idealizations; recompute after changing adjacency, width, sampling or boundaries.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者獨立設定的假想數值例，非引用機構的實測資料；來源支援領域定義與架構。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical values, not institutional measurements; sources support definitions and architecture.

courses.title: 檢索增強生成知識平台
courses.summary: 以檢索、神經生成與證據忠實度串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
courses.summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect retrieval, neural generation and evidence faithfulness with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.

stages.title: 資料與切片

stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop data and chunks through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

knowledge.textEn: A synthetic query has 10 relevant chunks; top five retrieve three, giving precision@5=0.6 and recall@5=0.3. Three supported claims among four verifiable claims give support rate 0.75, not overall answer accuracy.

Assign source IDs and paragraph addresses to a self-made manual.

steps.title: 切片邊界：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「切片邊界」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for chunk boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「切片邊界」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：切片過短會失去條件，過長會稀釋檢索訊號。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「比較自製公式與假設是否落在同切片。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for chunk boundaries. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Short chunks lose conditions; long chunks dilute retrieval signals. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Check whether formulas and assumptions stay in one chunk. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 比較自製公式與假設是否落在同切片。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Check whether formulas and assumptions stay in one chunk. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：每個切片字數相同就代表語意完整。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Equal chunk lengths imply complete semantics. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「切片邊界」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「比較自製公式與假設是否落在同切片。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for chunk boundaries; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.text: 切片過短會失去條件，過長會稀釋檢索訊號。

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 比較自製公式與假設是否落在同切片。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Check whether formulas and assumptions stay in one chunk. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

quiz.question: 審查「切片邊界」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for chunk boundaries?
options: 每個切片字數相同就代表語意完整。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「切片邊界」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
切片過短會失去條件，過長會稀釋檢索訊號。
optionsEn: Equal chunk lengths imply complete semantics.
One matching output proves chunk boundaries for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
Short chunks lose conditions; long chunks dilute retrieval signals.
quiz.explanation: 切片過短會失去條件，過長會稀釋檢索訊號。 比較自製公式與假設是否落在同切片。 因此「每個切片字數相同就代表語意完整。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。

steps.title: 切片邊界：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「切片邊界」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for chunk boundaries.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「比較自製公式與假設是否落在同切片。」；將結果與「切片過短會失去條件，過長會稀釋檢索訊號。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。

steps.observationEn: Check whether formulas and assumptions stay in one chunk. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Equal chunk lengths imply complete semantics. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「切片邊界」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「每個切片字數相同就代表語意完整。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for chunk boundaries; explain why this claim fails: Equal chunk lengths imply complete semantics.

steps.title: 嵌入表示：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「嵌入表示」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。

steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for embedding representations. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Embedding similarity reflects model representations, not physical truth. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare synonymous and numerically opposite self-made sentences. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.observationEn: Compare synonymous and numerically opposite self-made sentences. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.

quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for embedding representations?
options: 最高餘弦相似度的句子必然正確。

steps.title: 嵌入表示：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「嵌入表示」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for embedding representations.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「比較同義與數值相反的自製工程句。」；將結果與「向量相近表示模型相似性，不保證物理正確。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。

Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.

steps.check: 提交「嵌入表示」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「最高餘弦相似度的句子必然正確。」為何不成立。

steps.title: 提示信任：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「提示信任」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for prompt trust.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「用自製含無害錯誤指示的檔案驗證隔離。」；將結果與「來源內容是資料，不能自動提升為系統指令。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Test separation using self-made harmless misleading text. Compare results against: Source content is data, not automatically system authority. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 用自製含無害錯誤指示的檔案驗證隔離。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Test separation using self-made harmless misleading text. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Document instructions override system rules. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「提示信任」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「檔案裡的指示都應優先於系統規則。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for prompt trust; explain why this claim fails: Document instructions override system rules.

steps.title: 上下文預算：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「上下文預算」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for context budget.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「上下文預算」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：token 限制需保留問題、來源和回答空間。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「計算玩具提示加入切片後的剩餘容量。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。

Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Token limits reserve space for question, evidence and output. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Calculate remaining capacity after adding toy chunks. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 計算玩具提示加入切片後的剩餘容量。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Calculate remaining capacity after adding toy chunks. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：輸入塞滿全部視窗就不影響輸出。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Filling the input window never affects output. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「上下文預算」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「計算玩具提示加入切片後的剩餘容量。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for context budget; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

steps.title: 參數與啟用：原理與架構
steps.titleEn: Parameters and activations: principles and architecture
steps.objective: 以「參數與啟用」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for parameters and activations.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「參數與啟用」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：權重、啟用與快取有不同生命週期。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「畫單請求與多請求的記憶體共享範圍。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。

State an observable prediction before planning this check: Draw memory sharing for one and multiple requests. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
