knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 畫單請求與多請求的記憶體共享範圍。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Draw memory sharing for one and multiple requests. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 假想 7×10⁹ 個參數、每個 2 bytes 的權重佔 14 GB 十進位，約 13.04 GiB；不含快取及執行開銷。若 32 層、32 KV 頭、頭維 128、2048 token、FP16，單序列 KV≈2×32×32×128×2048×2=1 GiB；GQA 改變 KV 頭數。
knowledge.textEn: Seven billion two-byte parameters occupy 14 decimal GB, about 13.04 GiB, excluding runtime and caches. A 32-layer, 32-KV-head, head-size-128, 2,048-token FP16 sequence needs about 1 GiB of KV; GQA changes the KV-head count.

quiz.explanationEn: Weights, activations and caches have different lifetimes. Draw memory sharing for one and multiple requests. The alternative "Model-file size equals total memory needs." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「詞元表示」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：token 化影響序列長度與語言成本。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「比較自製繁中、英文和公式的 token 數。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for token representations. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Tokenization affects sequence length and language costs. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare token counts of self-made Chinese, English and formulas. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 比較自製繁中、英文和公式的 token 數。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Compare token counts of self-made Chinese, English and formulas. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：同字數不同語言必然同 token 數。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Equal character counts imply equal token counts across languages. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「詞元表示」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「比較自製繁中、英文和公式的 token 數。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for token representations; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「比較自製繁中、英文和公式的 token 數。」；將結果與「token 化影響序列長度與語言成本。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。

knowledge.textEn: Autoregressive tokens cannot read future positions.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 畫三 token 下三角可見矩陣。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Draw a three-token lower-triangular visibility matrix. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

quiz.question: 審查「因果遮罩」的驗證方法時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which validation approach is justified for causal masks?
options: 生成時每個 token 都可看到未來真實答案。
先把「因果遮罩」的顯示結果調到符合預期，再把這次吻合當作獨立驗證。
畫三 token 下三角可見矩陣。
optionsEn: Generated tokens can see future true answers.
Tune the displayed causal masks result to the expected value and count that agreement as independent validation.
Draw a three-token lower-triangular visibility matrix.
quiz.explanation: 自迴歸 token 不能讀取尚未生成的未來位置。 畫三 token 下三角可見矩陣。 因此「生成時每個 token 都可看到未來真實答案。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Autoregressive tokens cannot read future positions. Draw a three-token lower-triangular visibility matrix. The alternative "Generated tokens can see future true answers." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 多頭與 GQA：原理與架構
steps.titleEn: Multihead and GQA: principles and architecture
steps.objective: 以「多頭與 GQA」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for multihead and gqa.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「多頭與 GQA」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：Q 頭與 KV 頭可以不同數，影響快取容量。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「比較 32 Q 頭配 32 和 8 KV 頭的容量。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for multihead and gqa. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Query and KV head counts can differ, affecting cache size. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare 32 query heads with 32 versus 8 KV heads. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 比較 32 Q 頭配 32 和 8 KV 頭的容量。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Compare 32 query heads with 32 versus 8 KV heads. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：GQA 必然保留與 MHA 相同 KV 容量。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: GQA necessarily retains MHA cache capacity. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「多頭與 GQA」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「比較 32 Q 頭配 32 和 8 KV 頭的容量。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for multihead and gqa; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: Q 頭與 KV 頭可以不同數，影響快取容量。
knowledge.textEn: Query and KV head counts can differ, affecting cache size.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 比較 32 Q 頭配 32 和 8 KV 頭的容量。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Compare 32 query heads with 32 versus 8 KV heads. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

quiz.question: 審查「多頭與 GQA」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for multihead and gqa?
options: Q 頭與 KV 頭可以不同數，影響快取容量。
GQA 必然保留與 MHA 相同 KV 容量。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「多頭與 GQA」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: Query and KV head counts can differ, affecting cache size.
GQA necessarily retains MHA cache capacity.
One matching output proves multihead and gqa for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
quiz.explanation: Q 頭與 KV 頭可以不同數，影響快取容量。 比較 32 Q 頭配 32 和 8 KV 頭的容量。 因此「GQA 必然保留與 MHA 相同 KV 容量。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Query and KV head counts can differ, affecting cache size. Compare 32 query heads with 32 versus 8 KV heads. The alternative "GQA necessarily retains MHA cache capacity." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 多頭與 GQA：實驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Multihead and GQA: experiments and evidence
steps.objective: 以「多頭與 GQA」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for multihead and gqa.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「比較 32 Q 頭配 32 和 8 KV 頭的容量。」；將結果與「Q 頭與 KV 頭可以不同數，影響快取容量。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Compare 32 query heads with 32 versus 8 KV heads. Compare results against: Query and KV head counts can differ, affecting cache size. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 比較 32 Q 頭配 32 和 8 KV 頭的容量。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Compare 32 query heads with 32 versus 8 KV heads. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：GQA 必然保留與 MHA 相同 KV 容量。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: GQA necessarily retains MHA cache capacity. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「多頭與 GQA」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「GQA 必然保留與 MHA 相同 KV 容量。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for multihead and gqa; explain why this claim fails: GQA necessarily retains MHA cache capacity.

knowledge.textEn: First-token, per-token, tail latency and quality are reported together.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 建立合成請求矩陣並保留失敗案例。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Build a synthetic request matrix and retain failures. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 假想 7×10⁹ 個參數、每個 2 bytes 的權重佔 14 GB 十進位，約 13.04 GiB；不含快取及執行開銷。若 32 層、32 KV 頭、頭維 128、2048 token、FP16，單序列 KV≈2×32×32×128×2048×2=1 GiB；GQA 改變 KV 頭數。
knowledge.textEn: Seven billion two-byte parameters occupy 14 decimal GB, about 13.04 GiB, excluding runtime and caches. A 32-layer, 32-KV-head, head-size-128, 2,048-token FP16 sequence needs about 1 GiB of KV; GQA changes the KV-head count.

quiz.question: 審查「服務驗收」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for service acceptance?
options: 只報每秒 token 就證明服務適合所有使用者。
首 token、每 token、尾延遲與品質應一起報告。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「服務驗收」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: Tokens per second alone proves universal service suitability.
First-token, per-token, tail latency and quality are reported together.
One matching output proves service acceptance for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
quiz.explanation: 首 token、每 token、尾延遲與品質應一起報告。 建立合成請求矩陣並保留失敗案例。 因此「只報每秒 token 就證明服務適合所有使用者。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: First-token, per-token, tail latency and quality are reported together. Build a synthetic request matrix and retain failures. The alternative "Tokens per second alone proves universal service suitability." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 服務驗收：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「服務驗收」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for service acceptance.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「建立合成請求矩陣並保留失敗案例。」；將結果與「首 token、每 token、尾延遲與品質應一起報告。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Build a synthetic request matrix and retain failures. Compare results against: First-token, per-token, tail latency and quality are reported together. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 建立合成請求矩陣並保留失敗案例。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Build a synthetic request matrix and retain failures. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只報每秒 token 就證明服務適合所有使用者。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Tokens per second alone proves universal service suitability. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「服務驗收」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「只報每秒 token 就證明服務適合所有使用者。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for service acceptance; explain why this claim fails: Tokens per second alone proves universal service suitability.

courses.scope: 公開原理的本地科教模擬與工程判讀。只使用自製、合成或明確授權的資料；不操作真實受害主機、他人帳號、工業控制或超算設施。數值不代表廠商規格或實測效能，完成課程不是專業資格、真實裝置操作經歷或生產部署認證。
courses.scopeEn: Local educational simulation and engineering interpretation of public principles. Use self-made, synthetic or explicitly licensed data only; do not operate real victim hosts, other accounts, industrial control or supercomputing facilities. Values are not product specifications or measured performance. Completion is not a qualification, real-equipment experience or production-deployment certification.

workedExample.text: 假想 7×10⁹ 個參數、每個 2 bytes 的權重佔 14 GB 十進位，約 13.04 GiB；不含快取及執行開銷。若 32 層、32 KV 頭、頭維 128、2048 token、FP16，單序列 KV≈2×32×32×128×2048×2=1 GiB；GQA 改變 KV 頭數。

workedExample.assumptions: 使用算例明列的單位、分佈、精度、拓撲與理想化條件；改變鄰接、位寬、取樣或系統邊界必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated units, distributions, precision, topology and idealizations; recompute after changing adjacency, width, sampling or boundaries.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者獨立設定的假想數值例，非引用機構的實測資料；來源支援領域定義與架構。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical values, not institutional measurements; sources support definitions and architecture.

courses.title: 機器學習資料版本管理
courses.summary: 以資料版本、管線相依與訓練重現串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
courses.summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect data versions, pipeline dependencies and training reproduction with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.

stages.title: 來源與身份
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「來源與身份」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop origins and identity through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 資料身分：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「資料身分」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for data identity.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「資料身分」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：資料內容、來源和版本應有可核對識別。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「對自製小表儲存摘要與來源說明。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for data identity. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Content, provenance and versions need checkable identifiers. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Record digests and provenance for a self-made table. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 對自製小表儲存摘要與來源說明。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Record digests and provenance for a self-made table. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：資料夾名稱相同就表示內容相同。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Equal folder names imply equal content. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「資料身分」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「對自製小表儲存摘要與來源說明。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for data identity; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 資料內容、來源和版本應有可核對識別。
knowledge.textEn: Content, provenance and versions need checkable identifiers.

knowledge.text: 對自製小表儲存摘要與來源說明。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Record digests and provenance for a self-made table. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 假想 100 GB 資料每版僅改 5 GB、保留 10 版：完整複製需 1000 GB；若真實可重用固定內容塊，理想需 100+9×5=145 GB，節省 85.5%。壓縮、區塊邊界、去重與版本保留仍影響實際值。
knowledge.textEn: Ten full 100-GB copies need 1,000 GB. If only 5 GB changes per version and unchanged blocks are genuinely reusable, ideal storage is 145 GB, an 85.5% saving. Compression, boundaries, deduplication and retention alter actual costs.

資料內容、來源和版本應有可核對識別。
optionsEn: Equal folder names imply equal content.
One matching output proves data identity for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
Content, provenance and versions need checkable identifiers.

steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for content digests.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「改變合成一行記錄並比較摘要。」；將結果與「摘要辨別內容變化但不證明標註質量。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Change one synthetic row and compare digests. Compare results against: Digests distinguish changes without proving label quality. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 改變合成一行記錄並比較摘要。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Change one synthetic row and compare digests. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：雜湊正確代表每個標註正確。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Correct hashes prove every label correct. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「內容摘要」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「雜湊正確代表每個標註正確。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for content digests; explain why this claim fails: Correct hashes prove every label correct.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 摘要辨別內容變化但不證明標註質量。
knowledge.textEn: Digests distinguish changes without proving label quality.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 改變合成一行記錄並比較摘要。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Change one synthetic row and compare digests. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

quiz.question: 審查「內容摘要」的驗證方法時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which validation approach is justified for content digests?
options: 雜湊正確代表每個標註正確。
先把「內容摘要」的顯示結果調到符合預期，再把這次吻合當作獨立驗證。
改變合成一行記錄並比較摘要。
optionsEn: Correct hashes prove every label correct.
Tune the displayed content digests result to the expected value and count that agreement as independent validation.
Change one synthetic row and compare digests.
quiz.explanation: 摘要辨別內容變化但不證明標註質量。 改變合成一行記錄並比較摘要。 因此「雜湊正確代表每個標註正確。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Digests distinguish changes without proving label quality. Change one synthetic row and compare digests. The alternative "Correct hashes prove every label correct." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 資料清單：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「資料清單」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for data manifests.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「資料清單」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：清單連線檔案、大小、格式與必要許可權。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「讓同學僅依清單找到自製輸入。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for data manifests. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Manifests connect files, sizes, formats and permissions. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Have a peer locate self-made inputs from a manifest. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 讓同學僅依清單找到自製輸入。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Have a peer locate self-made inputs from a manifest. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只保留資料總大小就能重現版本。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Total size alone reproduces a version. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「資料清單」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「讓同學僅依清單找到自製輸入。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for data manifests; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.textEn: Manifests connect files, sizes, formats and permissions.

knowledge.textEn: Have a peer locate self-made inputs from a manifest. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

quiz.question: 審查「資料清單」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for data manifests?
options: 清單連線檔案、大小、格式與必要許可權。
只保留資料總大小就能重現版本。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「資料清單」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: Manifests connect files, sizes, formats and permissions.
Total size alone reproduces a version.
One matching output proves data manifests for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
quiz.explanation: 清單連線檔案、大小、格式與必要許可權。 讓同學僅依清單找到自製輸入。 因此「只保留資料總大小就能重現版本。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Manifests connect files, sizes, formats and permissions. Have a peer locate self-made inputs from a manifest. The alternative "Total size alone reproduces a version." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

stages.title: 版本與儲存
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「版本與儲存」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop versions and storage through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 程式碼資料分離：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「程式碼資料分離」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for code/data separation.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「程式碼資料分離」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：大型資料可在物件儲存，程式碼留版本控制。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「畫玩具 Git metadata 與資料物件對應。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for code/data separation. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Large data can live in object storage while code is versioned. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Map toy Git metadata to data objects. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 畫玩具 Git metadata 與資料物件對應。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Map toy Git metadata to data objects. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：大型權重必須全部放普通 Git 才能追蹤。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Large weights must be in ordinary Git to be tracked. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「程式碼資料分離」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「畫玩具 Git metadata 與資料物件對應。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for code/data separation; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for immutable versions. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Pinned versions prevent training-time data changes. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare pinned and floating-latest inputs. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Fixed download URLs imply immutable content. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「不可變版本」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「比較指定版本與漂浮最新版本的結果。」如何辨別它們。

quiz.question: 審查「隨機性版本」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？

options: 固定種子保證跨所有硬體逐位元相同。
種子、演算法、裝置與版本皆影響可重現程度。

optionsEn: A seed guarantees bitwise identity on every device.
Seeds, algorithms, devices and versions affect reproducibility.
One matching output proves randomness versions for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
quiz.explanation: 種子、演算法、裝置與版本皆影響可重現程度。 比較固定種子但不同程式版本的輸出。 因此「固定種子保證跨所有硬體逐位元相同。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。

steps.objective: 以「隨機性版本」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for randomness versions.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「比較固定種子但不同程式版本的輸出。」；將結果與「種子、演算法、裝置與版本皆影響可重現程度。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for delivery acceptance; explain why this claim fails: Unzipping proves research reproducibility.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 交付需驗證內容、執行與授權三種完整性。
knowledge.textEn: Delivery checks content, execution and rights integrity.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 讓同學用無私人資料的封包重現小訓練。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Have a peer reproduce toy training without private data. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 假想 100 GB 資料每版僅改 5 GB、保留 10 版：完整複製需 1000 GB；若真實可重用固定內容塊，理想需 100+9×5=145 GB，節省 85.5%。壓縮、區塊邊界、去重與版本保留仍影響實際值。
knowledge.textEn: Ten full 100-GB copies need 1,000 GB. If only 5 GB changes per version and unchanged blocks are genuinely reusable, ideal storage is 145 GB, an 85.5% saving. Compression, boundaries, deduplication and retention alter actual costs.

quiz.question: 審查「交付驗收」的驗證方法時，哪個說法成立？

optionsEn: Have a peer reproduce toy training without private data.

courses.scope: 公開原理的本地科教模擬與工程判讀。只使用自製、合成或明確授權的資料；不操作真實受害主機、他人帳號、工業控制或超算設施。數值不代表廠商規格或實測效能，完成課程不是專業資格、真實裝置操作經歷或生產部署認證。
courses.scopeEn: Local educational simulation and engineering interpretation of public principles. Use self-made, synthetic or explicitly licensed data only; do not operate real victim hosts, other accounts, industrial control or supercomputing facilities. Values are not product specifications or measured performance. Completion is not a qualification, real-equipment experience or production-deployment certification.

workedExample.assumptions: 使用算例明列的單位、分佈、精度、拓撲與理想化條件；改變鄰接、位寬、取樣或系統邊界必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated units, distributions, precision, topology and idealizations; recompute after changing adjacency, width, sampling or boundaries.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者獨立設定的假想數值例，非引用機構的實測資料；來源支援領域定義與架構。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical values, not institutional measurements; sources support definitions and architecture.

courses.title: 模型監測與漂移偵測
courses.summary: 以資料漂移、品質與模型效能分離串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
courses.summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect separation of data drift, quality and model performance with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.

stages.title: 基準與資料
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「基準與資料」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop references and data through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 基準版本：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「基準版本」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for reference versions.

steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for reference versions. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Comparisons pin reference data, windows and model versions. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Build versions for self-made monitoring data. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 建立自製監測資料的版本表。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。

steps.failure: 常見誤判：最新資料總是最佳且唯一基準。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: The latest data is always the sole best reference. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「基準版本」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「建立自製監測資料的版本表。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for reference versions; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 假想基準 N(0,1) 與執行 N(0.5,1)，均值偏移為 0.5 個基準標準差。兩批各 n=100 時均值差標準誤 sqrt(1/100+1/100)=0.1414，z≈3.536；此理想檢驗假設獨立常態且不是效能下降證明。
knowledge.textEn: Synthetic reference N(0,1) and current N(0.5,1) differ by 0.5 reference deviations. Two independent n=100 batches give mean-difference SE=0.1414 and z≈3.536 under normal assumptions; drift is not proof of performance loss.

options: 把合成異常分成品質與分佈兩類。
所有資料異常都可稱概念漂移。
先把「資料品質」的顯示結果調到符合預期，再把這次吻合當作獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Classify synthetic anomalies as quality or distribution changes.
Every data anomaly is concept drift.
Tune the displayed data quality result to the expected value and count that agreement as independent validation.
quiz.explanation: 缺測、重複與格式錯誤和分佈漂移不同。 把合成異常分成品質與分佈兩類。 因此「所有資料異常都可稱概念漂移。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Missingness, duplication and format errors differ from drift. Classify synthetic anomalies as quality or distribution changes. The alternative "Every data anomaly is concept drift." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 特徵漂移：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「特徵漂移」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for feature drift.

Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Changing P(x) need not change P(y∣x). Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Construct shifted inputs with unchanged toy rules. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.title: 特徵漂移：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「特徵漂移」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for feature drift.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「構造輸入平移但規則仍成立的玩具案例。」；將結果與「P(x) 改變不必然改變 P(y∣x)。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。

Exercise: Construct shifted inputs with unchanged toy rules. Compare results against: Changing P(x) need not change P(y∣x). Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 構造輸入平移但規則仍成立的玩具案例。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。

steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for feature drift; explain why this claim fails: Input shifts necessarily invalidate a model.

steps.observationEn: Simulate alerts from 20 hypothetical independent tests. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：每欄 5% 閾值意味總誤報也為 5%。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。

steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for multiple comparisons; explain why this claim fails: Five percent per column means five percent overall false alarms.

stages.title: 效能與告警
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「效能與告警」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。

steps.title: 標籤延遲：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「標籤延遲」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for delayed labels.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「標籤延遲」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：執行效能可能在真實標籤到達後才能評估。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「畫預測、標籤到達與指標更新時間線。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for delayed labels. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Operational performance may need delayed labels. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Draw prediction, label-arrival and metric-update times. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 畫預測、標籤到達與指標更新時間線。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Draw prediction, label-arrival and metric-update times. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：沒有標籤也可直接算真實準確率。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: True accuracy is available without labels. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「標籤延遲」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「畫預測、標籤到達與指標更新時間線。」如何辨別它們。

courses.scope: 公開原理的本地科教模擬與工程判讀。只使用自製、合成或明確授權的資料；不操作真實受害主機、他人帳號、工業控制或超算設施。數值不代表廠商規格或實測效能，完成課程不是專業資格、真實裝置操作經歷或生產部署認證。
courses.scopeEn: Local educational simulation and engineering interpretation of public principles. Use self-made, synthetic or explicitly licensed data only; do not operate real victim hosts, other accounts, industrial control or supercomputing facilities. Values are not product specifications or measured performance. Completion is not a qualification, real-equipment experience or production-deployment certification.

workedExample.title: 含假設的可重算工程例
workedExample.text: 假想基準 N(0,1) 與執行 N(0.5,1)，均值偏移為 0.5 個基準標準差。兩批各 n=100 時均值差標準誤 sqrt(1/100+1/100)=0.1414，z≈3.536；此理想檢驗假設獨立常態且不是效能下降證明。
workedExample.textEn: Synthetic reference N(0,1) and current N(0.5,1) differ by 0.5 reference deviations. Two independent n=100 batches give mean-difference SE=0.1414 and z≈3.536 under normal assumptions; drift is not proof of performance loss.
workedExample.assumptions: 使用算例明列的單位、分佈、精度、拓撲與理想化條件；改變鄰接、位寬、取樣或系統邊界必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated units, distributions, precision, topology and idealizations; recompute after changing adjacency, width, sampling or boundaries.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者獨立設定的假想數值例，非引用機構的實測資料；來源支援領域定義與架構。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical values, not institutional measurements; sources support definitions and architecture.

courses.title: 向量資料庫相似度搜尋
courses.summary: 以向量距離、近似索引與召回成本串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
courses.summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect vector distances, approximate indexes and recall cost with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.

stages.title: 表示與距離
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「表示與距離」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。

steps.title: 表示版本：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「表示版本」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for representation versions.

steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for representation versions. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Different embedding models generally have incompatible coordinates. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Add model and dimension versions to synthetic vectors. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 給合成向量加模型與維度版本。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Add model and dimension versions to synthetic vectors. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：維度相同便代表不同模型向量相容。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Equal dimensions imply cross-model compatibility. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「表示版本」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「給合成向量加模型與維度版本。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for representation versions; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 不同嵌入模型的向量座標通常不可混用。
knowledge.textEn: Different embedding models generally have incompatible coordinates.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 給合成向量加模型與維度版本。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Add model and dimension versions to synthetic vectors. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 玩具向量 x=(3,4)、y=(4,3)，範數皆為 5，餘弦相似度=24/25=0.96，Euclidean 距離=√2≈1.414。單位向量距離平方=2(1−cos)=0.08；未正規化時此式不能直接沿用。
knowledge.textEn: Toy x=(3,4), y=(4,3) both have norm 5, cosine 0.96 and Euclidean distance sqrt(2). For normalized vectors, squared distance is 2(1−cos)=0.08; the identity cannot be applied unchanged to unnormalized inputs.

quiz.question: 審查「表示版本」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for representation versions?
options: 維度相同便代表不同模型向量相容。
不同嵌入模型的向量座標通常不可混用。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「表示版本」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: Equal dimensions imply cross-model compatibility.
Different embedding models generally have incompatible coordinates.
One matching output proves representation versions for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
quiz.explanation: 不同嵌入模型的向量座標通常不可混用。 給合成向量加模型與維度版本。 因此「維度相同便代表不同模型向量相容。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Different embedding models generally have incompatible coordinates. Add model and dimension versions to synthetic vectors. The alternative "Equal dimensions imply cross-model compatibility." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.check: 提交「表示版本」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「維度相同便代表不同模型向量相容。」為何不成立。

knowledge.text: 用自製合成音或本人同意短句設任務。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Use synthetic audio or personally consented utterances. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 假想 16 kHz 單聲道 PCM16 每秒為 16000×2=32000 bytes。320 ms 一塊有 5120 樣本、10240 bytes；若需額外 80 ms 右文，單塊聲學可見範圍 400 ms。模型計算與端點判斷另加延遲。
knowledge.textEn: Synthetic 16-kHz mono PCM16 uses 32,000 bytes/s. A 320-ms chunk has 5,120 samples and 10,240 bytes. Adding 80-ms right context makes 400 ms visible audio; compute and endpoint decisions add latency.

quiz.question: 審查「同意與範圍」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？

語音可能包含個人資訊，錄音需有明確同意。
optionsEn: Microphone permission permits permanent public recordings.
One matching output proves consent and scope for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
Speech can contain personal information; recording needs explicit consent.
quiz.explanation: 語音可能包含個人資訊，錄音需有明確同意。 用自製合成音或本人同意短句設任務。 因此「瀏覽器允許麥克風等於允許永久公開錄音。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Speech can contain personal information; recording needs explicit consent. Use synthetic audio or personally consented utterances. The alternative "Microphone permission permits permanent public recordings." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 同意與範圍：實驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Consent and scope: experiments and evidence
steps.objective: 以「同意與範圍」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for consent and scope.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「用自製合成音或本人同意短句設任務。」；將結果與「語音可能包含個人資訊，錄音需有明確同意。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Use synthetic audio or personally consented utterances. Compare results against: Speech can contain personal information; recording needs explicit consent. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 用自製合成音或本人同意短句設任務。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。

steps.check: 提交「同意與範圍」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「瀏覽器允許麥克風等於允許永久公開錄音。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for consent and scope; explain why this claim fails: Microphone permission permits permanent public recordings.

steps.title: 取樣與別名：原理與架構
steps.titleEn: Sampling and aliasing: principles and architecture
steps.objective: 以「取樣與別名」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for sampling and aliasing.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「取樣與別名」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：取樣率及前置低通限制可保留頻率。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「比較自製低頻音不同取樣率頻譜。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for sampling and aliasing. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Sampling rate and antialias filtering bound retained frequencies. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare synthetic tones at different sample rates. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 比較自製低頻音不同取樣率頻譜。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Compare synthetic tones at different sample rates. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：提高位深就自動提高最高保留頻率。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: More bit depth automatically raises retained bandwidth. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「取樣與別名」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「比較自製低頻音不同取樣率頻譜。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for sampling and aliasing; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

steps.titleEn: Frames and spectra: principles and architecture
steps.objective: 以「幀與譜」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for frames and spectra.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「幀與譜」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：短時窗用區域性平穩假設提取頻率特徵。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「計算玩具窗長、hop 與每秒幀數。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for frames and spectra. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Short windows extract features under local stationarity assumptions. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Calculate toy window, hop and frames per second. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 計算玩具窗長、hop 與每秒幀數。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Calculate toy window, hop and frames per second. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：窗越長時頻解析度都必然越好。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Longer windows always improve both resolutions. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「幀與譜」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「計算玩具窗長、hop 與每秒幀數。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for frames and spectra; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 短時窗用區域性平穩假設提取頻率特徵。
knowledge.textEn: Short windows extract features under local stationarity assumptions.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 計算玩具窗長、hop 與每秒幀數。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Calculate toy window, hop and frames per second. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

quiz.question: 審查「幀與譜」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for frames and spectra?
options: 窗越長時頻解析度都必然越好。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「幀與譜」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
短時窗用區域性平穩假設提取頻率特徵。
optionsEn: Longer windows always improve both resolutions.
One matching output proves frames and spectra for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
Short windows extract features under local stationarity assumptions.
quiz.explanation: 短時窗用區域性平穩假設提取頻率特徵。 計算玩具窗長、hop 與每秒幀數。 因此「窗越長時頻解析度都必然越好。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Short windows extract features under local stationarity assumptions. Calculate toy window, hop and frames per second. The alternative "Longer windows always improve both resolutions." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 幀與譜：實驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Frames and spectra: experiments and evidence
steps.objective: 以「幀與譜」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for frames and spectra.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「計算玩具窗長、hop 與每秒幀數。」；將結果與「短時窗用區域性平穩假設提取頻率特徵。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Calculate toy window, hop and frames per second. Compare results against: Short windows extract features under local stationarity assumptions. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 計算玩具窗長、hop 與每秒幀數。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Calculate toy window, hop and frames per second. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：窗越長時頻解析度都必然越好。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Longer windows always improve both resolutions. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「幀與譜」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「窗越長時頻解析度都必然越好。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for frames and spectra; explain why this claim fails: Longer windows always improve both resolutions.

quiz.questionEn: Which validation approach is justified for frames and spectra?
options: 計算玩具窗長、hop 與每秒幀數。
窗越長時頻解析度都必然越好。
先把「幀與譜」的顯示結果調到符合預期，再把這次吻合當作獨立驗證。

steps.title: CTC 對齊：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「CTC 對齊」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for ctc alignment.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「CTC 對齊」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：CTC 合併重複符號並去 blank 形成文字。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「手算兩條含 blank 的玩具標籤路徑。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。

State an observable prediction before planning this check: Collapse two toy label paths containing blanks. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

knowledge.textEn: Collapse two toy label paths containing blanks. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

quiz.question: 審查「CTC 對齊」的驗證方法時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which validation approach is justified for ctc alignment?
options: CTC 的 blank 就是普通空白字元。
手算兩條含 blank 的玩具標籤路徑。
先把「CTC 對齊」的顯示結果調到符合預期，再把這次吻合當作獨立驗證。
optionsEn: CTC blank is an ordinary space character.
Collapse two toy label paths containing blanks.
Tune the displayed ctc alignment result to the expected value and count that agreement as independent validation.
quiz.explanation: CTC 合併重複符號並去 blank 形成文字。 手算兩條含 blank 的玩具標籤路徑。 因此「CTC 的 blank 就是普通空白字元。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: CTC merges repeats and removes blanks to form text. Collapse two toy label paths containing blanks. The alternative "CTC blank is an ordinary space character." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: RNN-T 因子：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「RNN-T 因子」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for rnn-t factors.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「RNN-T 因子」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：轉導器結合聲學編碼、預測網路與聯合網路。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「分開畫聲音與已輸出 token 的路徑。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for rnn-t factors. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Transducers combine acoustic, prediction and joint networks. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Draw separate acoustic and previous-token pathways. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 分開畫聲音與已輸出 token 的路徑。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Draw separate acoustic and previous-token pathways. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：RNN-T 只有一個聲學 softmax。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: RNN-T contains only one acoustic softmax. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「RNN-T 因子」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「分開畫聲音與已輸出 token 的路徑。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for rnn-t factors; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

quiz.question: 審查「RNN-T 因子」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for rnn-t factors?
options: RNN-T 只有一個聲學 softmax。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「RNN-T 因子」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
轉導器結合聲學編碼、預測網路與聯合網路。
optionsEn: RNN-T contains only one acoustic softmax.
One matching output proves rnn-t factors for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
Transducers combine acoustic, prediction and joint networks.
quiz.explanation: 轉導器結合聲學編碼、預測網路與聯合網路。 分開畫聲音與已輸出 token 的路徑。 因此「RNN-T 只有一個聲學 softmax。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Transducers combine acoustic, prediction and joint networks. Draw separate acoustic and previous-token pathways. The alternative "RNN-T contains only one acoustic softmax." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: RNN-T 因子：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「RNN-T 因子」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for rnn-t factors.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「分開畫聲音與已輸出 token 的路徑。」；將結果與「轉導器結合聲學編碼、預測網路與聯合網路。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Draw separate acoustic and previous-token pathways. Compare results against: Transducers combine acoustic, prediction and joint networks. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 分開畫聲音與已輸出 token 的路徑。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Draw separate acoustic and previous-token pathways. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：RNN-T 只有一個聲學 softmax。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: RNN-T contains only one acoustic softmax. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「RNN-T 因子」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「RNN-T 只有一個聲學 softmax。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for rnn-t factors; explain why this claim fails: RNN-T contains only one acoustic softmax.

steps.title: 塊與重疊：原理與架構

State an observable prediction before planning this check: Recalculate sample counts and mark overlap regions. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare greedy and two-path candidates on a small vocabulary. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

options: 反射與陰影可改變缺陷特徵而非缺陷本身。
暗色區域必然就是材料缺陷。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「照明對比」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: Reflection and shadows change appearance without changing defects.
Every dark region is a material defect.
One matching output proves lighting contrast for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
quiz.explanation: 反射與陰影可改變缺陷特徵而非缺陷本身。 比較自製同形狀圖的兩種照明。 因此「暗色區域必然就是材料缺陷。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Reflection and shadows change appearance without changing defects. Compare two illuminations of the same self-made shape. The alternative "Every dark region is a material defect." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 照明對比：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「照明對比」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for lighting contrast.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「比較自製同形狀圖的兩種照明。」；將結果與「反射與陰影可改變缺陷特徵而非缺陷本身。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Compare two illuminations of the same self-made shape. Compare results against: Reflection and shadows change appearance without changing defects. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 比較自製同形狀圖的兩種照明。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Compare two illuminations of the same self-made shape. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：暗色區域必然就是材料缺陷。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Every dark region is a material defect. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「照明對比」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「暗色區域必然就是材料缺陷。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for lighting contrast; explain why this claim fails: Every dark region is a material defect.

stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop data and networks through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 資料切分：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「資料切分」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for dataset splits.

steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for dataset splits. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Views of one part must not leak across training and test. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Split by toy part IDs. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 按玩具工件 ID 分組切分。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Split by toy part IDs. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：隨機按照片切分永遠獨立。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Random image splits are always independent. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「資料切分」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「按玩具工件 ID 分組切分。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for dataset splits; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

steps.objective: 以「卷積參數」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for convolution parameters.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「卷積參數」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：標準卷積參數量由核尺寸與輸入／輸出通道決定；輸出尺寸另依輸入形狀、步長與 padding 決定，步長本身不改參數量。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「重算本課卷積尺寸、參數與 MAC。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。

Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Standard convolution parameter counts depend on kernel size and input/output channels; output shapes additionally depend on input shape, stride and padding. Stride alone does not change parameter count. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Recalculate example shapes, parameters and MACs. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for drift tracking.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「為玩具環境變更制定再次驗證題集。」；將結果與「新鏡頭、照明與材料改變輸入分佈。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Define repeat tests after toy environmental changes. Compare results against: New lenses, lighting and materials shift inputs. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 為玩具環境變更制定再次驗證題集。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Define repeat tests after toy environmental changes. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：一次標定透過就保證永久準確。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: One calibration guarantees permanent accuracy. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「漂移追蹤」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「一次標定透過就保證永久準確。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for drift tracking; explain why this claim fails: One calibration guarantees permanent accuracy.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 新鏡頭、照明與材料改變輸入分佈。
knowledge.textEn: New lenses, lighting and materials shift inputs.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 為玩具環境變更制定再次驗證題集。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Define repeat tests after toy environmental changes. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

quiz.question: 審查「漂移追蹤」的驗證方法時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which validation approach is justified for drift tracking?
options: 一次標定透過就保證永久準確。
先把「漂移追蹤」的顯示結果調到符合預期，再把這次吻合當作獨立驗證。
為玩具環境變更制定再次驗證題集。
optionsEn: One calibration guarantees permanent accuracy.
Tune the displayed drift tracking result to the expected value and count that agreement as independent validation.
Define repeat tests after toy environmental changes.
quiz.explanation: 新鏡頭、照明與材料改變輸入分佈。 為玩具環境變更制定再次驗證題集。 因此「一次標定透過就保證永久準確。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: New lenses, lighting and materials shift inputs. Define repeat tests after toy environmental changes. The alternative "One calibration guarantees permanent accuracy." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 工程驗收：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「工程驗收」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for engineering acceptance.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「工程驗收」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：產線驗收需結合失誤成本、時延與可追溯性。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「輸出合成樣本的分組誤差與失敗示例。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for engineering acceptance. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Acceptance combines error costs, delay and traceability. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Report group errors and failure examples for synthetic samples. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 輸出合成樣本的分組誤差與失敗示例。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Report group errors and failure examples for synthetic samples. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：每秒幀數足夠就代表工程質量合格。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Enough frames per second proves engineering quality. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「工程驗收」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「輸出合成樣本的分組誤差與失敗示例。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for engineering acceptance; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 產線驗收需結合失誤成本、時延與可追溯性。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance combines error costs, delay and traceability.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 輸出合成樣本的分組誤差與失敗示例。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Report group errors and failure examples for synthetic samples. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 玩具卷積輸入 32×32×3，核 3×3、stride1、padding1、輸出 16 通道：輸出 32×32×16；權重 3×3×3×16=432，加偏置為 448 參數；直接卷積約 32×32×16×27=442368 MAC，1 MAC 是否算 2 FLOP 必須宣告。
knowledge.textEn: A toy 32×32×3 input with 3×3 kernels, stride 1, padding 1 and 16 outputs gives 32×32×16 activations, 448 parameters including biases and 442,368 MACs. Declare whether one MAC is counted as two FLOPs.

quiz.question: 審查「工程驗收」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for engineering acceptance?
options: 產線驗收需結合失誤成本、時延與可追溯性。
每秒幀數足夠就代表工程質量合格。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「工程驗收」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: Acceptance combines error costs, delay and traceability.
Enough frames per second proves engineering quality.
One matching output proves engineering acceptance for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
quiz.explanation: 產線驗收需結合失誤成本、時延與可追溯性。 輸出合成樣本的分組誤差與失敗示例。 因此「每秒幀數足夠就代表工程質量合格。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Acceptance combines error costs, delay and traceability. Report group errors and failure examples for synthetic samples. The alternative "Enough frames per second proves engineering quality." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

courses.scope: 公開原理的本地科教模擬與工程判讀。只使用自製、合成或明確授權的資料；不操作真實受害主機、他人帳號、工業控制或超算設施。數值不代表廠商規格或實測效能，完成課程不是專業資格、真實裝置操作經歷或生產部署認證。
courses.scopeEn: Local educational simulation and engineering interpretation of public principles. Use self-made, synthetic or explicitly licensed data only; do not operate real victim hosts, other accounts, industrial control or supercomputing facilities. Values are not product specifications or measured performance. Completion is not a qualification, real-equipment experience or production-deployment certification.

workedExample.title: 含假設的可重算工程例
workedExample.text: 玩具卷積輸入 32×32×3，核 3×3、stride1、padding1、輸出 16 通道：輸出 32×32×16；權重 3×3×3×16=432，加偏置為 448 參數；直接卷積約 32×32×16×27=442368 MAC，1 MAC 是否算 2 FLOP 必須宣告。
workedExample.textEn: A toy 32×32×3 input with 3×3 kernels, stride 1, padding 1 and 16 outputs gives 32×32×16 activations, 448 parameters including biases and 442,368 MACs. Declare whether one MAC is counted as two FLOPs.
workedExample.assumptions: 使用算例明列的單位、分佈、精度、拓撲與理想化條件；改變鄰接、位寬、取樣或系統邊界必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated units, distributions, precision, topology and idealizations; recompute after changing adjacency, width, sampling or boundaries.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者獨立設定的假想數值例，非引用機構的實測資料；來源支援領域定義與架構。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical values, not institutional measurements; sources support definitions and architecture.

courses.title: 工業數位分身資料平台
courses.summary: 以物理狀態、事件資料與分身一致性串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
courses.summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect physical state, event data and twin consistency with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.

stages.title: 實體與語意
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「實體與語意」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop entities and semantics through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 實體標識：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「實體標識」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for entity identifiers.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「實體標識」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：物理裝置與數字實體需穩定對映。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「給三臺玩具裝置建序號與分身 ID。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for entity identifiers. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Physical devices need stable mappings to digital entities. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Map serials and twin IDs for three toy devices. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 給三臺玩具裝置建序號與分身 ID。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Map serials and twin IDs for three toy devices. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：裝置換名就必須成為同一個舊分身。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Renaming a device guarantees identity with an old twin. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「實體標識」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「給三臺玩具裝置建序號與分身 ID。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for entity identifiers; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.text: 給三臺玩具裝置建序號與分身 ID。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 假想溫度感測器每秒 10 次、每筆 40 bytes，1000 個感測器原始資料率=400000 bytes/s，約 0.4 MB/s；一天 34.56 GB 十進位。訊息封裝、索引、副本和重送不在此值內。
knowledge.textEn: A synthetic fleet of 1,000 sensors at 10 samples/s and 40 bytes/sample produces 400,000 bytes/s or 34.56 decimal GB/day, before message framing, indexes, replication and retries.

options: 裝置換名就必須成為同一個舊分身。

只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「實體標識」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。

One matching output proves entity identifiers for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.

knowledge.textEn: Map serials and twin IDs for three toy devices. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 假想溫度感測器每秒 10 次、每筆 40 bytes，1000 個感測器原始資料率=400000 bytes/s，約 0.4 MB/s；一天 34.56 GB 十進位。訊息封裝、索引、副本和重送不在此值內。
knowledge.textEn: A synthetic fleet of 1,000 sensors at 10 samples/s and 40 bytes/sample produces 400,000 bytes/s or 34.56 decimal GB/day, before message framing, indexes, replication and retries.

quiz.question: 審查「實體標識」的驗證方法時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which validation approach is justified for entity identifiers?
options: 裝置換名就必須成為同一個舊分身。
先把「實體標識」的顯示結果調到符合預期，再把這次吻合當作獨立驗證。
給三臺玩具裝置建序號與分身 ID。
optionsEn: Renaming a device guarantees identity with an old twin.
Tune the displayed entity identifiers result to the expected value and count that agreement as independent validation.
Map serials and twin IDs for three toy devices.
quiz.explanation: 物理裝置與數字實體需穩定對映。 給三臺玩具裝置建序號與分身 ID。 因此「裝置換名就必須成為同一個舊分身。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Physical devices need stable mappings to digital entities. Map serials and twin IDs for three toy devices. The alternative "Renaming a device guarantees identity with an old twin." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 屬性與能力：原理與架構
steps.titleEn: Properties and capabilities: principles and architecture
steps.objective: 以「屬性與能力」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for properties and capabilities.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「屬性與能力」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：當前狀態與可執行能力是不同語意。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「區分合成溫度值與允許設定動作。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for properties and capabilities. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Current state differs from executable capability. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Separate synthetic temperatures from allowed setpoints. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 區分合成溫度值與允許設定動作。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Separate synthetic temperatures from allowed setpoints. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：能顯示狀態就代表能控制真實裝置。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Displaying state implies controlling the real device. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「屬性與能力」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「區分合成溫度值與允許設定動作。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for properties and capabilities; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

quiz.question: 審查「屬性與能力」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for properties and capabilities?
options: 當前狀態與可執行能力是不同語意。
能顯示狀態就代表能控制真實裝置。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「屬性與能力」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: Current state differs from executable capability.
Displaying state implies controlling the real device.
One matching output proves properties and capabilities for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
quiz.explanation: 當前狀態與可執行能力是不同語意。 區分合成溫度值與允許設定動作。 因此「能顯示狀態就代表能控制真實裝置。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Current state differs from executable capability. Separate synthetic temperatures from allowed setpoints. The alternative "Displaying state implies controlling the real device." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 屬性與能力：實驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Properties and capabilities: experiments and evidence
steps.objective: 以「屬性與能力」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for properties and capabilities.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「區分合成溫度值與允許設定動作。」；將結果與「當前狀態與可執行能力是不同語意。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Separate synthetic temperatures from allowed setpoints. Compare results against: Current state differs from executable capability. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 區分合成溫度值與允許設定動作。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Separate synthetic temperatures from allowed setpoints. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：能顯示狀態就代表能控制真實裝置。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Displaying state implies controlling the real device. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「屬性與能力」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「能顯示狀態就代表能控制真實裝置。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for properties and capabilities; explain why this claim fails: Displaying state implies controlling the real device.

steps.title: 事件排序：原理與架構

Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Retries and reordering require deduplication and ordering rules. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Inject duplicates and reordering into synthetic messages. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.check: 提交「事件排序」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「在合成訊息序列注入重複及亂序。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for event ordering; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

訊息傳到一次就保證只處理一次。

steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「重算本課資料率與一天容量。」；將結果與「取樣頻率、記錄大小與數量決定原始資料率。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Recalculate example traffic and daily capacity. Compare results against: Rate, record size and device count set raw traffic. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 重算本課資料率與一天容量。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Recalculate example traffic and daily capacity. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：原始資料率已經包含所有副本與索引。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Raw traffic includes all replicas and indexes. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「流量預算」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「原始資料率已經包含所有副本與索引。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for traffic budgets; explain why this claim fails: Raw traffic includes all replicas and indexes.

quiz.question: 審查「流量預算」的驗證方法時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which validation approach is justified for traffic budgets?
options: 原始資料率已經包含所有副本與索引。
先把「流量預算」的顯示結果調到符合預期，再把這次吻合當作獨立驗證。
重算本課資料率與一天容量。
optionsEn: Raw traffic includes all replicas and indexes.
Tune the displayed traffic budgets result to the expected value and count that agreement as independent validation.

State an observable prediction before planning this check: Add age and quality flags to fictional states. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.check: 提交「連線失效」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「為假想狀態新增年齡與品質標記。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for connection failures; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

steps.objective: 以「物理模型」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。

steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for physical models. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Physical-model parameters and observations need identifiability and bounds. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Fit synthetic data with an assumed first-order thermal model. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.check: 提交「物理模型」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「用假想一階熱模型擬合合成資料。」如何辨別它們。
