steps.title: 資料同化：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「資料同化」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for data assimilation.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「比較玩具高噪聲與低噪聲感測權重。」；將結果與「預測與量測融合需依誤差模型賦權。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Compare high- and low-noise toy measurement weights. Compare results against: Prediction-observation fusion weights error models. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 比較玩具高噪聲與低噪聲感測權重。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Compare high- and low-noise toy measurement weights. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：每個感測器永遠應有相同權重。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Every sensor always needs equal weight. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「資料同化」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「每個感測器永遠應有相同權重。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for data assimilation; explain why this claim fails: Every sensor always needs equal weight.

steps.title: 不確定度：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「不確定度」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「不確定度」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：分身估計不是對真實裝置的完全觀測。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「對合成熱預測報告範圍與缺測。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for uncertainty. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Twin estimates are not complete observations of reality. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Report ranges and missingness in synthetic thermal predictions. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 對合成熱預測報告範圍與缺測。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Report ranges and missingness in synthetic thermal predictions. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：數字分身狀態必然無誤差。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Digital-twin states are necessarily error-free. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「不確定度」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「對合成熱預測報告範圍與缺測。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for uncertainty; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

stages.title: 許可權與驗收
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「許可權與驗收」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop permissions and acceptance through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 許可權策略：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「許可權策略」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for permission policies.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「許可權策略」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：讀狀態、寫設定與管理策略應分權。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「在玩具 API 圖分開三類角色許可權。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for permission policies. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. steps.objective: 以「分身驗收」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for twin acceptance.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「分身驗收」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：驗收需量測陳舊度、一致性與預測誤差。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「用合成亂序與缺測測試完整鏈。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。

State an observable prediction before planning this check: Test the chain with synthetic reordering and missingness. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 驗收需量測陳舊度、一致性與預測誤差。

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 用合成亂序與缺測測試完整鏈。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Test the chain with synthetic reordering and missingness. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

quiz.question: 審查「分身驗收」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？

驗收需量測陳舊度、一致性與預測誤差。

Acceptance measures staleness, consistency and prediction errors.

steps.check: 提交「分身驗收」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「3D 外觀真實就代表模型與物理一致。」為何不成立。

courses.scope: 公開原理的本地科教模擬與工程判讀。只使用自製、合成或明確授權的資料；不操作真實受害主機、他人帳號、工業控制或超算設施。數值不代表廠商規格或實測效能，完成課程不是專業資格、真實裝置操作經歷或生產部署認證。

Use self-made, synthetic or explicitly licensed data only; do not operate real victim hosts, other accounts, industrial control or supercomputing facilities. courses.title: 地理資訊瓦片服務
courses.summary: 以投影、瓦片矩陣與空間服務一致性串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
courses.summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect projections, tile matrices and spatial-service consistency with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.

stages.title: 座標與資料

Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Tile matrix sets define CRS, grid size and origin. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Draw two toy matrix levels and indices. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.check: 提交「矩陣定義」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「手畫兩層玩具格網及索引。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for matrix definitions; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

steps.objective: 以「矩陣定義」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。

State an observable prediction before planning this check: Label dates and unknown regions on a self-made map. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例

courses.scope: 公開原理的本地科教模擬與工程判讀。只使用自製、合成或明確授權的資料；不操作真實受害主機、他人帳號、工業控制或超算設施。數值不代表廠商規格或實測效能，完成課程不是專業資格、真實裝置操作經歷或生產部署認證。
courses.scopeEn: Local educational simulation and engineering interpretation of public principles. Use self-made, synthetic or explicitly licensed data only; do not operate real victim hosts, other accounts, industrial control or supercomputing facilities. Values are not product specifications or measured performance. Completion is not a qualification, real-equipment experience or production-deployment certification.

courses.title: 三維渲染引擎
courses.summary: 以幾何變換、光照與 GPU 管線同步串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
courses.summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect geometry transforms, lighting and gpu pipeline synchronization with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.

stages.title: 座標與取樣
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「座標與取樣」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop coordinates and sampling through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 世界座標：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「世界座標」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for world coordinates.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「世界座標」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：模型、世界、檢視與投影座標各有變換。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「手算自製點透過兩次平移與旋轉。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for world coordinates. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Model, world, view and projection coordinates have separate transforms. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Transform a self-made point through translations and rotations. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 手算自製點透過兩次平移與旋轉。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Transform a self-made point through translations and rotations. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：變換矩陣可隨意交換順序。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Transform matrices may be reordered freely. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「世界座標」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「手算自製點透過兩次平移與旋轉。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for world coordinates; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.textEn: A synthetic 1920×1080 RGBA8 frame is 8,294,400 bytes; two buffers use 16.59 decimal MB. At 60 writes/s, raw color writes are about 0.498 GB/s, excluding depth, MSAA, texture reads and compression.

courses.scope: 公開原理的本地科教模擬與工程判讀。只使用自製、合成或明確授權的資料；不操作真實受害主機、他人帳號、工業控制或超算設施。數值不代表廠商規格或實測效能，完成課程不是專業資格、真實裝置操作經歷或生產部署認證。
courses.scopeEn: Local educational simulation and engineering interpretation of public principles. Use self-made, synthetic or explicitly licensed data only; do not operate real victim hosts, other accounts, industrial control or supercomputing facilities. Values are not product specifications or measured performance. Completion is not a qualification, real-equipment experience or production-deployment certification.

workedExample.assumptions: 使用算例明列的單位、分佈、精度、拓撲與理想化條件；改變鄰接、位寬、取樣或系統邊界必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated units, distributions, precision, topology and idealizations; recompute after changing adjacency, width, sampling or boundaries.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者獨立設定的假想數值例，非引用機構的實測資料；來源支援領域定義與架構。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical values, not institutional measurements; sources support definitions and architecture.

courses.title: 科學高效能計算排程
courses.summary: 以資源分配、佇列政策與科學工作重現串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
courses.summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect resource allocation, queue policies and scientific reproducibility with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.

stages.title: 工作與資源
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「工作與資源」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop jobs and resources through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 工作邊界：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「工作邊界」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for job boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「工作邊界」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：任務、工作步驟與資源分配是不同實體。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「畫玩具作業包含兩種步驟的結構。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for job boundaries. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Tasks, job steps and allocations are distinct entities. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Draw a toy job with two step types. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 畫玩具作業包含兩種步驟的結構。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Draw a toy job with two step types. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：一份指令碼就等於一個 CPU 任務。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: One script equals one CPU task. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「工作邊界」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「畫玩具作業包含兩種步驟的結構。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for job boundaries; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.textEn: Draw a toy job with two step types. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 假想作業用 8 節點、每節點 32 core、執行 2 小時，計量為 16 node-hours 與 512 core-hours。若 40% 時間等待通訊，不可直接說有效工作只有 307.2 core-hours；等待也佔分配資源，利用率需額外量測。
knowledge.textEn: An eight-node, 32-core/node job running two hours consumes 16 node-hours and 512 core-hours. Communication waiting still occupies allocated resources; measured utilization cannot be inferred merely by subtracting wait fractions.

quiz.question: 審查「工作邊界」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for job boundaries?
options: 一份指令碼就等於一個 CPU 任務。
任務、工作步驟與資源分配是不同實體。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「工作邊界」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: One script equals one CPU task.
Tasks, job steps and allocations are distinct entities.
One matching output proves job boundaries for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
quiz.explanation: 任務、工作步驟與資源分配是不同實體。 畫玩具作業包含兩種步驟的結構。 因此「一份指令碼就等於一個 CPU 任務。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Tasks, job steps and allocations are distinct entities. Draw a toy job with two step types. The alternative "One script equals one CPU task." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 回填排程：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「回填排程」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for backfill scheduling.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「回填排程」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：小工作可在不延遲已保留工作前回填空隙。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「在紙上時間表放入一個短工作。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for backfill scheduling. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Small jobs can fill gaps without delaying reservations. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Place a short job into a paper schedule gap. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.observationEn: Place a short job into a paper schedule gap. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Backfill always permits indefinitely delaying large jobs. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「回填排程」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「在紙上時間表放入一個短工作。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for backfill scheduling; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

optionsEn: Backfill always permits indefinitely delaying large jobs.

steps.title: 回填排程：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「回填排程」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for backfill scheduling.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「在紙上時間表放入一個短工作。」；將結果與「小工作可在不延遲已保留工作前回填空隙。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。

knowledge.textEn: Compare two preemptions for a hypothetical checkpointed job. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

quiz.question: 審查「可搶佔性」的驗證方法時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which validation approach is justified for preemptibility?
options: 終止後再啟動一定無需任何恢復。
對假想 checkpoint 作業比較兩次搶佔。
先把「可搶佔性」的顯示結果調到符合預期，再把這次吻合當作獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Restarting always needs no recovery.
Compare two preemptions for a hypothetical checkpointed job.
Tune the displayed preemptibility result to the expected value and count that agreement as independent validation.
quiz.explanation: 搶佔需考慮儲存、恢復與重複計算成本。 對假想 checkpoint 作業比較兩次搶佔。 因此「終止後再啟動一定無需任何恢復。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Preemption accounts for saving, restoring and repeated work. Compare two preemptions for a hypothetical checkpointed job. The alternative "Restarting always needs no recovery." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

stages.title: 執行與恢復
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「執行與恢復」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop execution and recovery through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 任務繫結：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「任務繫結」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for task binding.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「任務繫結」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：程序與執行緒繫結至 CPU 核心／NUMA 節點會影響共享與記憶體局部性。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「畫玩具兩插槽執行緒與資料位置。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for task binding. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Binding processes and threads to CPU cores/NUMA nodes affects sharing and memory locality. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Map threads and data on two toy sockets. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 畫玩具兩插槽執行緒與資料位置。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Map threads and data on two toy sockets. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：執行緒在哪個插槽都不影響記憶體存取。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Thread sockets never affect memory access. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「任務繫結」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「畫玩具兩插槽執行緒與資料位置。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for task binding; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

quiz.question: 審查「任務繫結」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for task binding?
options: 執行緒在哪個插槽都不影響記憶體存取。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「任務繫結」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
程序與執行緒繫結至 CPU 核心／NUMA 節點會影響共享與記憶體局部性。
optionsEn: Thread sockets never affect memory access.
One matching output proves task binding for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
Binding processes and threads to CPU cores/NUMA nodes affects sharing and memory locality.
quiz.explanation: 程序與執行緒繫結至 CPU 核心／NUMA 節點會影響共享與記憶體局部性。 畫玩具兩插槽執行緒與資料位置。 因此「執行緒在哪個插槽都不影響記憶體存取。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Binding processes and threads to CPU cores/NUMA nodes affects sharing and memory locality. Map threads and data on two toy sockets. The alternative "Thread sockets never affect memory access." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 任務繫結：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「任務繫結」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for task binding.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「畫玩具兩插槽執行緒與資料位置。」；將結果與「程序與執行緒繫結至 CPU 核心／NUMA 節點會影響共享與記憶體局部性。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Map threads and data on two toy sockets. Compare results against: Binding processes and threads to CPU cores/NUMA nodes affects sharing and memory locality. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Thread sockets never affect memory access. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「任務繫結」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「執行緒在哪個插槽都不影響記憶體存取。」為何不成立。

Exercise: Draw data persistence after a toy job ends. Compare results against: Node temporary storage is not durable artifact storage. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 畫玩具作業結束後資料遷移路徑。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Draw data persistence after a toy job ends. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Successful exit guarantees permanent outputs. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「輸出儲存」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「程式成功退出即保證輸出永遠存在。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for output persistence; explain why this claim fails: Successful exit guarantees permanent outputs.

steps.objective: 以「檢查點」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。

State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare two intervals on a fictional failure timeline. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.check: 提交「檢查點」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「在假想故障時間線比較兩種間隔。」如何辨別它們。

courses.title: 大型 MPI 平行模擬
courses.summary: 以域分解、訊息語意與數值平行驗證串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
courses.summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect domain decomposition, message semantics and numerical parallel validation with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.

stages.title: 問題與分解
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「問題與分解」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop problems and decomposition through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 域分解：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「域分解」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for domain decomposition.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「域分解」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：空間分塊決定計算與跨塊依賴。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「把自製二維格網分為四塊。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for domain decomposition. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Spatial partitioning defines compute and interblock dependencies. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Partition a self-made 2D grid into four blocks. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 把自製二維格網分為四塊。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Partition a self-made 2D grid into four blocks. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：分塊越細就無條件降低總耗時。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Finer blocks always reduce total runtime. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「域分解」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「把自製二維格網分為四塊。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for domain decomposition; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 空間分塊決定計算與跨塊依賴。
knowledge.textEn: Spatial partitioning defines compute and interblock dependencies.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 把自製二維格網分為四塊。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Partition a self-made 2D grid into four blocks. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 玩具 3D 網格每子域邊長 L，體點 L³、單層六面 halo≈6L²，通訊體積比≈6/L。L=32 得 0.1875，L=64 得 0.09375；未含邊角、重疊與協議頭，不等於通訊時間比例。
knowledge.textEn: For a toy cubic subdomain, L3 interior cells and roughly 6L2 one-layer halo cells give volume ratio 6/L: 0.1875 at L32 and 0.09375 at L64, excluding edges, overlap and framing; not a time fraction.

quiz.question: 審查「域分解」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for domain decomposition?
options: 分塊越細就無條件降低總耗時。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「域分解」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
空間分塊決定計算與跨塊依賴。
optionsEn: Finer blocks always reduce total runtime.
One matching output proves domain decomposition for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
Spatial partitioning defines compute and interblock dependencies.
quiz.explanation: 空間分塊決定計算與跨塊依賴。 把自製二維格網分為四塊。 因此「分塊越細就無條件降低總耗時。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Spatial partitioning defines compute and interblock dependencies. Partition a self-made 2D grid into four blocks. The alternative "Finer blocks always reduce total runtime." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 域分解：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「域分解」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for domain decomposition.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「把自製二維格網分為四塊。」；將結果與「空間分塊決定計算與跨塊依賴。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Partition a self-made 2D grid into four blocks. Compare results against: Spatial partitioning defines compute and interblock dependencies. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 把自製二維格網分為四塊。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Partition a self-made 2D grid into four blocks. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：分塊越細就無條件降低總耗時。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Finer blocks always reduce total runtime. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「域分解」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「分塊越細就無條件降低總耗時。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for domain decomposition; explain why this claim fails: Finer blocks always reduce total runtime.

quiz.questionEn: Which validation approach is justified for domain decomposition?
options: 把自製二維格網分為四塊。
分塊越細就無條件降低總耗時。
先把「域分解」的顯示結果調到符合預期，再把這次吻合當作獨立驗證。

State an observable prediction before planning this check: Draw data ownership for two ranks with two threads each. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.check: 提交「程序與執行緒」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「畫兩 rank 各兩執行緒的資料所有權。」如何辨別它們。

steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「比較同程序在兩個玩具群組的 rank。」；將結果與「通訊域隔離訊息集合並定義 rank 身份。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Compare one process’s ranks in two toy groups. Compare results against: Communicators isolate message groups and rank identities. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 比較同程序在兩個玩具群組的 rank。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Compare one process’s ranks in two toy groups. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：rank 編號在任何通訊域中都不變。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Ranks never change across communicators. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「Communicator」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「rank 編號在任何通訊域中都不變。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for communicators; explain why this claim fails: Ranks never change across communicators.

knowledge.textEn: Communicators isolate message groups and rank identities.

knowledge.text: 比較同程序在兩個玩具群組的 rank。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Compare one process’s ranks in two toy groups. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

quiz.question: 審查「Communicator」的驗證方法時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which validation approach is justified for communicators?
options: rank 編號在任何通訊域中都不變。
比較同程序在兩個玩具群組的 rank。
先把「Communicator」的顯示結果調到符合預期，再把這次吻合當作獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Ranks never change across communicators.
Compare one process’s ranks in two toy groups.
Tune the displayed communicators result to the expected value and count that agreement as independent validation.

steps.title: 邊界條件：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「邊界條件」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。

steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for boundary conditions. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Physical and interdomain boundaries are handled differently. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Mark both boundary types on a toy diffusion grid. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 標示玩具擴散格網的兩種邊界。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Mark both boundary types on a toy diffusion grid. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有子域邊界都應設零值。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Every subdomain boundary should be zero. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「邊界條件」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「標示玩具擴散格網的兩種邊界。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for boundary conditions; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

steps.title: 傳送匹配：原理與架構

State an observable prediction before planning this check: Match three toy send/receive records. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.objective: 以「阻塞語意」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for blocking semantics.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「阻塞語意」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：傳送返回與對端完成接收不總是同一事件。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「畫不同假想緩衝策略的時間線。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。

Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Draw timelines for hypothetical buffer strategies. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for checkpoint consistency.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「檢查點一致」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：檢查點需保留跨 rank 的相容狀態。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「對玩具步驟編號找不一致儲存。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for checkpoint consistency. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Checkpoints preserve compatible cross-rank states. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Find inconsistent saved steps in a toy run. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 對玩具步驟編號找不一致儲存。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Find inconsistent saved steps in a toy run. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：每 rank 任意時刻各自存檔就能正確恢復。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Arbitrary independent rank saves always restore correctly. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「檢查點一致」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「對玩具步驟編號找不一致儲存。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for checkpoint consistency; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 檢查點需保留跨 rank 的相容狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Checkpoints preserve compatible cross-rank states.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 對玩具步驟編號找不一致儲存。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Find inconsistent saved steps in a toy run. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

quiz.question: 審查「檢查點一致」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for checkpoint consistency?
options: 檢查點需保留跨 rank 的相容狀態。
每 rank 任意時刻各自存檔就能正確恢復。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「檢查點一致」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: Checkpoints preserve compatible cross-rank states.
Arbitrary independent rank saves always restore correctly.
One matching output proves checkpoint consistency for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
quiz.explanation: 檢查點需保留跨 rank 的相容狀態。 對玩具步驟編號找不一致儲存。 因此「每 rank 任意時刻各自存檔就能正確恢復。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Checkpoints preserve compatible cross-rank states. Find inconsistent saved steps in a toy run. The alternative "Arbitrary independent rank saves always restore correctly." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 檢查點一致：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「檢查點一致」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for checkpoint consistency.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「對玩具步驟編號找不一致儲存。」；將結果與「檢查點需保留跨 rank 的相容狀態。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Find inconsistent saved steps in a toy run. Compare results against: Checkpoints preserve compatible cross-rank states. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 對玩具步驟編號找不一致儲存。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Find inconsistent saved steps in a toy run. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：每 rank 任意時刻各自存檔就能正確恢復。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Arbitrary independent rank saves always restore correctly. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「檢查點一致」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「每 rank 任意時刻各自存檔就能正確恢復。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for checkpoint consistency; explain why this claim fails: Arbitrary independent rank saves always restore correctly.

quiz.question: 審查「檢查點一致」的驗證方法時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which validation approach is justified for checkpoint consistency?

先把「檢查點一致」的顯示結果調到符合預期，再把這次吻合當作獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Arbitrary independent rank saves always restore correctly.
Find inconsistent saved steps in a toy run.
Tune the displayed checkpoint consistency result to the expected value and count that agreement as independent validation.

Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 玩具 3D 網格每子域邊長 L，體點 L³、單層六面 halo≈6L²，通訊體積比≈6/L。L=32 得 0.1875，L=64 得 0.09375；未含邊角、重疊與協議頭，不等於通訊時間比例。
knowledge.textEn: For a toy cubic subdomain, L3 interior cells and roughly 6L2 one-layer halo cells give volume ratio 6/L: 0.1875 at L32 and 0.09375 at L64, excluding edges, overlap and framing; not a time fraction.

courses.scope: 公開原理的本地科教模擬與工程判讀。只使用自製、合成或明確授權的資料；不操作真實受害主機、他人帳號、工業控制或超算設施。數值不代表廠商規格或實測效能，完成課程不是專業資格、真實裝置操作經歷或生產部署認證。
courses.scopeEn: Local educational simulation and engineering interpretation of public principles. Use self-made, synthetic or explicitly licensed data only; do not operate real victim hosts, other accounts, industrial control or supercomputing facilities. Values are not product specifications or measured performance. Completion is not a qualification, real-equipment experience or production-deployment certification.

workedExample.text: 玩具 3D 網格每子域邊長 L，體點 L³、單層六面 halo≈6L²，通訊體積比≈6/L。L=32 得 0.1875，L=64 得 0.09375；未含邊角、重疊與協議頭，不等於通訊時間比例。

workedExample.assumptions: 使用算例明列的單位、分佈、精度、拓撲與理想化條件；改變鄰接、位寬、取樣或系統邊界必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated units, distributions, precision, topology and idealizations; recompute after changing adjacency, width, sampling or boundaries.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者獨立設定的假想數值例，非引用機構的實測資料；來源支援領域定義與架構。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical values, not institutional measurements; sources support definitions and architecture.

courses.title: 數值天氣預報計算管線
courses.summary: 以流體 PDE、資料同化與集合預報串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
courses.summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect fluid pdes, data assimilation and ensemble forecasts with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.

stages.title: 方程與觀測
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「方程與觀測」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop equations and observations through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 預報邊界：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「預報邊界」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for forecast boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「預報邊界」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：預測變數、空間域與時距定義任務。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「指定玩具溫度場的範圍與預報時段。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for forecast boundaries. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Variables, domain and lead time define the task. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Define a toy temperature field and forecast window. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 指定玩具溫度場的範圍與預報時段。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Define a toy temperature field and forecast window. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：天氣模式能無條件預測任意時距。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Weather models forecast arbitrary lead times unconditionally. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「預報邊界」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「指定玩具溫度場的範圍與預報時段。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for forecast boundaries; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 預測變數、空間域與時距定義任務。
knowledge.textEn: Variables, domain and lead time define the task.

knowledge.text: 指定玩具溫度場的範圍與預報時段。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Define a toy temperature field and forecast window. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 一維玩具平流速度 u=20 m/s、網距 Δx=1000 m，顯式格式取 CFL=uΔt/Δx≤0.8 得 Δt≤40 s。若網距減半而同 CFL，時間步須 ≤20 s；真實 IFS 可能用其他格式，本例不代表其執行配置。
knowledge.textEn: For a toy explicit 1D advection scheme with speed 20 m/s and spacing 1,000 m, CFL≤0.8 gives dt≤40 s. Halving spacing gives dt≤20 s at the same CFL; this does not represent operational IFS settings.

quiz.question: 審查「預報邊界」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for forecast boundaries?
options: 預測變數、空間域與時距定義任務。
天氣模式能無條件預測任意時距。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「預報邊界」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: Variables, domain and lead time define the task.
Weather models forecast arbitrary lead times unconditionally.
One matching output proves forecast boundaries for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
quiz.explanation: 預測變數、空間域與時距定義任務。 指定玩具溫度場的範圍與預報時段。 因此「天氣模式能無條件預測任意時距。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Variables, domain and lead time define the task. Define a toy temperature field and forecast window. The alternative "Weather models forecast arbitrary lead times unconditionally." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 預報邊界：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「預報邊界」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for forecast boundaries.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「指定玩具溫度場的範圍與預報時段。」；將結果與「預測變數、空間域與時距定義任務。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Define a toy temperature field and forecast window. Compare results against: Variables, domain and lead time define the task. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 指定玩具溫度場的範圍與預報時段。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Define a toy temperature field and forecast window. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：天氣模式能無條件預測任意時距。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Weather models forecast arbitrary lead times unconditionally. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「預報邊界」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「天氣模式能無條件預測任意時距。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for forecast boundaries; explain why this claim fails: Weather models forecast arbitrary lead times unconditionally.

steps.title: 守恆方程：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「守恆方程」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for conservation laws.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「守恆方程」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：質量、動量與能量約束天氣狀態演化。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「寫出玩具平流與擴散的守恆檢查。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for conservation laws. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Mass, momentum and energy constrain atmospheric evolution. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Write conservation checks for toy advection and diffusion. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 寫出玩具平流與擴散的守恆檢查。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Write conservation checks for toy advection and diffusion. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: High resolution automatically guarantees conservation. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「守恆方程」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「寫出玩具平流與擴散的守恆檢查。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for conservation laws; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

steps.titleEn: Background and innovations: principles and architecture
steps.objective: 以「背景與創新」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for background and innovations.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「背景與創新」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：同化創新為觀測與背景在觀測空間的差。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「對玩具線性 H 計算 y−Hx。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for background and innovations. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Assimilation innovations compare observations and background in observation space. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compute y−Hx for a toy linear H. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 對玩具線性 H 計算 y−Hx。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Compute y−Hx for a toy linear H. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：創新就是觀測減任意模型格點。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Innovation is observation minus any grid value. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「背景與創新」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「對玩具線性 H 計算 y−Hx。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for background and innovations; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 同化創新為觀測與背景在觀測空間的差。
knowledge.textEn: Assimilation innovations compare observations and background in observation space.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 對玩具線性 H 計算 y−Hx。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Compute y−Hx for a toy linear H. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

quiz.question: 審查「背景與創新」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for background and innovations?
options: 同化創新為觀測與背景在觀測空間的差。
創新就是觀測減任意模型格點。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「背景與創新」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: Assimilation innovations compare observations and background in observation space.
Innovation is observation minus any grid value.
One matching output proves background and innovations for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
quiz.explanation: 同化創新為觀測與背景在觀測空間的差。 對玩具線性 H 計算 y−Hx。 因此「創新就是觀測減任意模型格點。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Assimilation innovations compare observations and background in observation space. Compute y−Hx for a toy linear H. The alternative "Innovation is observation minus any grid value." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 背景與創新：實驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Background and innovations: experiments and evidence
steps.objective: 以「背景與創新」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for background and innovations.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「對玩具線性 H 計算 y−Hx。」；將結果與「同化創新為觀測與背景在觀測空間的差。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Compute y−Hx for a toy linear H. Compare results against: Assimilation innovations compare observations and background in observation space. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 對玩具線性 H 計算 y−Hx。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Compute y−Hx for a toy linear H. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：創新就是觀測減任意模型格點。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Innovation is observation minus any grid value. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「背景與創新」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「創新就是觀測減任意模型格點。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for background and innovations; explain why this claim fails: Innovation is observation minus any grid value.

quiz.question: 審查「背景與創新」的驗證方法時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which validation approach is justified for background and innovations?
options: 創新就是觀測減任意模型格點。
對玩具線性 H 計算 y−Hx。
先把「背景與創新」的顯示結果調到符合預期，再把這次吻合當作獨立驗證。

steps.title: 誤差權重：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「誤差權重」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for error weighting.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「誤差權重」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：背景和觀測誤差協方差決定融合權重。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「手算一維兩方差下的加權平均。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for error weighting. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Background and observation covariance determine fusion weights. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Calculate one-dimensional fusion for two variances. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 手算一維兩方差下的加權平均。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。

steps.check: 提交「誤差權重」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「手算一維兩方差下的加權平均。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for error weighting; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

stages.title: 計算與集合
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「計算與集合」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop computing and ensembles through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 參數化耦合：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「參數化耦合」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。

knowledge.textEn: Nonlinear dynamics evolve small initial differences with lead time.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 比較玩具短長時段軌跡分離。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Compare toy short/long-horizon trajectory separation. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

quiz.question: 審查「誤差增長」的驗證方法時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which validation approach is justified for error growth?
options: 雙精度可以完全消除天氣不確定。
先把「誤差增長」的顯示結果調到符合預期，再把這次吻合當作獨立驗證。
比較玩具短長時段軌跡分離。
optionsEn: Double precision removes all weather uncertainty.
Tune the displayed error growth result to the expected value and count that agreement as independent validation.
Compare toy short/long-horizon trajectory separation.
quiz.explanation: 非線性動態使小初始差異隨時距變化。 比較玩具短長時段軌跡分離。 因此「雙精度可以完全消除天氣不確定。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Nonlinear dynamics evolve small initial differences with lead time. Compare toy short/long-horizon trajectory separation. The alternative "Double precision removes all weather uncertainty." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

stages.title: 驗證與不確定
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「驗證與不確定」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop verification and uncertainty through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 確定性驗證：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「確定性驗證」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for deterministic verification.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「確定性驗證」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：均方誤差、偏差與區域平均衡量不同屬性。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「手算合成預報場的誤差與偏差。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for deterministic verification. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: RMSE, bias and regional means measure different properties. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Calculate errors and bias of synthetic forecasts. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 手算合成預報場的誤差與偏差。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Calculate errors and bias of synthetic forecasts. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：零平均偏差就表示每格預測正確。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Zero mean bias means every grid prediction is correct. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「確定性驗證」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「手算合成預報場的誤差與偏差。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for deterministic verification; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 均方誤差、偏差與區域平均衡量不同屬性。
knowledge.textEn: RMSE, bias and regional means measure different properties.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 手算合成預報場的誤差與偏差。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Calculate errors and bias of synthetic forecasts. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

quiz.question: 審查「確定性驗證」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for deterministic verification?
options: 均方誤差、偏差與區域平均衡量不同屬性。
零平均偏差就表示每格預測正確。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「確定性驗證」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: RMSE, bias and regional means measure different properties.
Zero mean bias means every grid prediction is correct.
One matching output proves deterministic verification for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
quiz.explanation: 均方誤差、偏差與區域平均衡量不同屬性。 手算合成預報場的誤差與偏差。 因此「零平均偏差就表示每格預測正確。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: RMSE, bias and regional means measure different properties. Calculate errors and bias of synthetic forecasts. The alternative "Zero mean bias means every grid prediction is correct." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 確定性驗證：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「確定性驗證」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for deterministic verification.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「手算合成預報場的誤差與偏差。」；將結果與「均方誤差、偏差與區域平均衡量不同屬性。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Calculate errors and bias of synthetic forecasts. Compare results against: RMSE, bias and regional means measure different properties. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 手算合成預報場的誤差與偏差。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Calculate errors and bias of synthetic forecasts. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：零平均偏差就表示每格預測正確。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Zero mean bias means every grid prediction is correct. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「確定性驗證」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「零平均偏差就表示每格預測正確。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for deterministic verification; explain why this claim fails: Zero mean bias means every grid prediction is correct.

courses.scope: 公開原理的本地科教模擬與工程判讀。只使用自製、合成或明確授權的資料；不操作真實受害主機、他人帳號、工業控制或超算設施。數值不代表廠商規格或實測效能，完成課程不是專業資格、真實裝置操作經歷或生產部署認證。
courses.scopeEn: Local educational simulation and engineering interpretation of public principles. Use self-made, synthetic or explicitly licensed data only; do not operate real victim hosts, other accounts, industrial control or supercomputing facilities. Values are not product specifications or measured performance. Completion is not a qualification, real-equipment experience or production-deployment certification.

workedExample.text: 一維玩具平流速度 u=20 m/s、網距 Δx=1000 m，顯式格式取 CFL=uΔt/Δx≤0.8 得 Δt≤40 s。若網距減半而同 CFL，時間步須 ≤20 s；真實 IFS 可能用其他格式，本例不代表其執行配置。

workedExample.assumptions: 使用算例明列的單位、分佈、精度、拓撲與理想化條件；改變鄰接、位寬、取樣或系統邊界必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated units, distributions, precision, topology and idealizations; recompute after changing adjacency, width, sampling or boundaries.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者獨立設定的假想數值例，非引用機構的實測資料；來源支援領域定義與架構。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical values, not institutional measurements; sources support definitions and architecture.

courses.title: CERN 全球 LHC 運算網格
courses.summary: 以分層科學資料處理與跨機構計算串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
courses.summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect tiered scientific processing and interinstitutional computing with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.

stages.title: 實驗與資料
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「實驗與資料」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。

steps.title: 科學鏈路：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「科學鏈路」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。

steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「科學鏈路」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：探測器資料、重建與分析有不同產物。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「畫玩具事件從原始到摘要的路徑。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。

steps.title: Tier-0 角色：原理與架構

Principle: Central reception and initial processing have defined responsibilities. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Mark central roles in the public architecture. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 標示公開架構中的中心角色。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。

steps.check: 提交「Tier-0 角色」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「標示公開架構中的中心角色。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for tier-0 roles; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

steps.title: Tier-0 角色：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「Tier-0 角色」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。

steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「科學交付」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：交付應含資料範圍、統計誤差和處理版本。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「讓同學重現自製事件直方圖。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for scientific delivery. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Delivery includes data scope, statistical errors and processing versions. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Have a peer reproduce self-made event histograms. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 讓同學重現自製事件直方圖。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Have a peer reproduce self-made event histograms. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：使用世界級網格保證所有科學結論正確。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Using a world-class grid guarantees correct conclusions. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「科學交付」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「讓同學重現自製事件直方圖。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for scientific delivery; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 交付應含資料範圍、統計誤差和處理版本。
knowledge.textEn: Delivery includes data scope, statistical errors and processing versions.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 讓同學重現自製事件直方圖。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Have a peer reproduce self-made event histograms. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 假想 1 PB 十進位資料需經穩定 10 Gbit/s 鏈路傳輸，理想下限 10¹⁵×8/10¹⁰=800000 s，約 9.26 天。協議、排隊、故障與複製會增加時間；不代表 WLCG 實際資料率。
knowledge.textEn: One synthetic decimal PB over a sustained 10-Gbit/s link has ideal minimum 800,000 s or 9.26 days. Protocols, queues, failures and replication add time; this is not an actual WLCG data rate.

quiz.question: 審查「科學交付」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for scientific delivery?
options: 使用世界級網格保證所有科學結論正確。
交付應含資料範圍、統計誤差和處理版本。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「科學交付」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: Using a world-class grid guarantees correct conclusions.
Delivery includes data scope, statistical errors and processing versions.
One matching output proves scientific delivery for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
quiz.explanation: 交付應含資料範圍、統計誤差和處理版本。 讓同學重現自製事件直方圖。 因此「使用世界級網格保證所有科學結論正確。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Delivery includes data scope, statistical errors and processing versions. Have a peer reproduce self-made event histograms. The alternative "Using a world-class grid guarantees correct conclusions." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 科學交付：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「科學交付」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for scientific delivery.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「讓同學重現自製事件直方圖。」；將結果與「交付應含資料範圍、統計誤差和處理版本。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Have a peer reproduce self-made event histograms. Compare results against: Delivery includes data scope, statistical errors and processing versions. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 讓同學重現自製事件直方圖。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Have a peer reproduce self-made event histograms. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Using a world-class grid guarantees correct conclusions. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「科學交付」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「使用世界級網格保證所有科學結論正確。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for scientific delivery; explain why this claim fails: Using a world-class grid guarantees correct conclusions.

courses.scope: 公開原理的本地科教模擬與工程判讀。只使用自製、合成或明確授權的資料；不操作真實受害主機、他人帳號、工業控制或超算設施。數值不代表廠商規格或實測效能，完成課程不是專業資格、真實裝置操作經歷或生產部署認證。
courses.scopeEn: Local educational simulation and engineering interpretation of public principles. Use self-made, synthetic or explicitly licensed data only; do not operate real victim hosts, other accounts, industrial control or supercomputing facilities. Values are not product specifications or measured performance. Completion is not a qualification, real-equipment experience or production-deployment certification.

workedExample.text: 假想 1 PB 十進位資料需經穩定 10 Gbit/s 鏈路傳輸，理想下限 10¹⁵×8/10¹⁰=800000 s，約 9.26 天。協議、排隊、故障與複製會增加時間；不代表 WLCG 實際資料率。

workedExample.assumptions: 使用算例明列的單位、分佈、精度、拓撲與理想化條件；改變鄰接、位寬、取樣或系統邊界必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated units, distributions, precision, topology and idealizations; recompute after changing adjacency, width, sampling or boundaries.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者獨立設定的假想數值例，非引用機構的實測資料；來源支援領域定義與架構。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical values, not institutional measurements; sources support definitions and architecture.

courses.title: Frontier 超級電腦架構
courses.summary: 以Frontier 異質節點、HBM 與通訊拓撲串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
courses.summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect frontier heterogeneous nodes, hbm and interconnect topology with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.

stages.title: 任務與節點
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「任務與節點」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。

Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Distinguish packages, GCDs and ranks for a toy task. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Principle: More nodes shrink local work and enlarge communication fractions. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare compute and communication in synthetic scaling tables. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.check: 提交「擴展瓶頸」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「比較合成強擴展表的計算與通訊。」如何辨別它們。

Principle: Fugaku uses CPU vector architecture rather than conventional external-GPU nodes. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare toy CPU-vector and GPU functional diagrams. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「向量化驗證」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：編譯器向量化需依賴、別名與對齊可判定。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「分析一個自製迴圈的讀寫依賴。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for vectorization checks. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Vectorization needs analyzable dependencies, aliasing and alignment. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Analyze read/write dependencies in a self-made loop. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.observationEn: Analyze read/write dependencies in a self-made loop. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Optimization flags guarantee every loop vectorized. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「向量化驗證」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「分析一個自製迴圈的讀寫依賴。」如何辨別它們。

options: 開啟最佳化旗標就保證所有迴圈向量化。

optionsEn: Optimization flags guarantee every loop vectorized.
One matching output proves vectorization checks for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.

steps.objective: 以「向量化驗證」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for vectorization checks.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「分析一個自製迴圈的讀寫依賴。」；將結果與「編譯器向量化需依賴、別名與對齊可判定。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。

List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 分析一個自製迴圈的讀寫依賴。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Optimization flags guarantee every loop vectorized. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「向量化驗證」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「開啟最佳化旗標就保證所有迴圈向量化。」為何不成立。

knowledge.text: 512-bit SVE 向量可容納 8 個 FP64 元素；若一指令為向量 FMA，每元素算乘加2 FLOP，則每指令 16 FLOP。48 核、2 GHz 且假想每週期僅一條 FMA 給 1.536 TFLOP/s；不能當實際峰值，因為發射能力需另查。
knowledge.textEn: A 512-bit SVE vector holds eight FP64 elements; one vector FMA counts 16 FLOPs under a two-operation convention. Forty-eight cores at 2 GHz with an assumed one FMA/cycle give 1.536 TFLOP/s, not an actual peak without issue-capability details.

steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「把本課玩具 kernel 移植為平臺中立分析。」；將結果與「比較需匹配問題、精度、版本和資源用量。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Analyze the toy kernel in platform-neutral terms. Compare results against: Comparisons align problem, precision, versions and usage. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 把本課玩具 kernel 移植為平臺中立分析。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Analyze the toy kernel in platform-neutral terms. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：排名數字可取代應用級比較。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Ranking numbers replace application comparisons. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「架構比較」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「排名數字可取代應用級比較。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for architecture comparison; explain why this claim fails: Ranking numbers replace application comparisons.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 比較需匹配問題、精度、版本和資源用量。
knowledge.textEn: Comparisons align problem, precision, versions and usage.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 把本課玩具 kernel 移植為平臺中立分析。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Analyze the toy kernel in platform-neutral terms. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 512-bit SVE 向量可容納 8 個 FP64 元素；若一指令為向量 FMA，每元素算乘加2 FLOP，則每指令 16 FLOP。48 核、2 GHz 且假想每週期僅一條 FMA 給 1.536 TFLOP/s；不能當實際峰值，因為發射能力需另查。
knowledge.textEn: A 512-bit SVE vector holds eight FP64 elements; one vector FMA counts 16 FLOPs under a two-operation convention. Forty-eight cores at 2 GHz with an assumed one FMA/cycle give 1.536 TFLOP/s, not an actual peak without issue-capability details.

quiz.question: 審查「架構比較」的驗證方法時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which validation approach is justified for architecture comparison?
options: 排名數字可取代應用級比較。
把本課玩具 kernel 移植為平臺中立分析。

optionsEn: Ranking numbers replace application comparisons.
Analyze the toy kernel in platform-neutral terms.
Tune the displayed architecture comparison result to the expected value and count that agreement as independent validation.

quiz.explanationEn: Comparisons align problem, precision, versions and usage. Analyze the toy kernel in platform-neutral terms. The alternative "Ranking numbers replace application comparisons." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

courses.scope: 公開原理的本地科教模擬與工程判讀。只使用自製、合成或明確授權的資料；不操作真實受害主機、他人帳號、工業控制或超算設施。數值不代表廠商規格或實測效能，完成課程不是專業資格、真實裝置操作經歷或生產部署認證。
courses.scopeEn: Local educational simulation and engineering interpretation of public principles. Use self-made, synthetic or explicitly licensed data only; do not operate real victim hosts, other accounts, industrial control or supercomputing facilities. Values are not product specifications or measured performance. Completion is not a qualification, real-equipment experience or production-deployment certification.

workedExample.title: 含假設的可重算工程例
workedExample.text: 512-bit SVE 向量可容納 8 個 FP64 元素；若一指令為向量 FMA，每元素算乘加2 FLOP，則每指令 16 FLOP。48 核、2 GHz 且假想每週期僅一條 FMA 給 1.536 TFLOP/s；不能當實際峰值，因為發射能力需另查。
workedExample.textEn: A 512-bit SVE vector holds eight FP64 elements; one vector FMA counts 16 FLOPs under a two-operation convention. Forty-eight cores at 2 GHz with an assumed one FMA/cycle give 1.536 TFLOP/s, not an actual peak without issue-capability details.
workedExample.assumptions: 使用算例明列的單位、分佈、精度、拓撲與理想化條件；改變鄰接、位寬、取樣或系統邊界必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated units, distributions, precision, topology and idealizations; recompute after changing adjacency, width, sampling or boundaries.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者獨立設定的假想數值例，非引用機構的實測資料；來源支援領域定義與架構。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical values, not institutional measurements; sources support definitions and architecture.

courses.title: Summit 超級電腦架構
courses.summary: 以Summit 的 POWER9、V100 與異質計算串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
courses.summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect summit power9, v100 and heterogeneous computing with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.

stages.title: 歷史與節點
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「歷史與節點」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop history and nodes through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 歷史架構：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「歷史架構」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for historical architecture.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「歷史架構」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：Summit 是 POWER9 與 V100 結合的歷史系統案例。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「按官方公開結構畫原創節點圖。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for historical architecture. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Summit is a historical POWER9/V100 system case. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Draw an original node diagram from public descriptions. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 按官方公開結構畫原創節點圖。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Draw an original node diagram from public descriptions. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：舊系統課程等於該系統今日仍接受所有工作。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: A historical course implies current unrestricted access. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「歷史架構」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「按官方公開結構畫原創節點圖。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for historical architecture; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.textEn: Draw an original node diagram from public descriptions. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 歷史 Summit 計算節點有 6 個 V100 GPU；假想每 GPU 一份 12 GiB 工作集，總為 72 GiB，但分散的裝置記憶體不能自動成為單一連續 72 GiB 陣列。若每輪主機裝置搬移 1 GB、50 GB/s 假想持續速率，單向下限 20 ms。
knowledge.textEn: A historical Summit compute node has six V100 GPUs. Six assumed 12-GiB worksets total 72 GiB but do not automatically form one contiguous array. One assumed 1-GB transfer at sustained 50 GB/s has a 20-ms one-way lower bound.

Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Place toy preprocessing and matrix kernels by role. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.title: Tensor Core：原理與架構

steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for tensor cores. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. State an observable prediction before planning this check: List accuracy needs for toy matrices. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
