knowledge.textEn: A historical Summit compute node has six V100 GPUs. Six assumed 12-GiB worksets total 72 GiB but do not automatically form one contiguous array. One assumed 1-GB transfer at sustained 50 GB/s has a 20-ms one-way lower bound.

quiz.question: 審查「科學複核」的驗證方法時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which validation approach is justified for scientific review?
options: 使用 Summit 字樣即證明原算例來自實測。
先把「科學複核」的顯示結果調到符合預期，再把這次吻合當作獨立驗證。
讓同學用本地小題重算科學約束。
optionsEn: The name Summit proves example values measured there.
Tune the displayed scientific review result to the expected value and count that agreement as independent validation.
Have a peer check scientific constraints on a small local task.
quiz.explanation: 重現需留任務定義與誤差，而非只留平臺名。 讓同學用本地小題重算科學約束。 因此「使用 Summit 字樣即證明原算例來自實測。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Reproduction retains tasks and errors, not just platform names. Have a peer check scientific constraints on a small local task. The alternative "The name Summit proves example values measured there." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

courses.scope: 公開原理的本地科教模擬與工程判讀。只使用自製、合成或明確授權的資料；不操作真實受害主機、他人帳號、工業控制或超算設施。數值不代表廠商規格或實測效能，完成課程不是專業資格、真實裝置操作經歷或生產部署認證。
courses.scopeEn: Local educational simulation and engineering interpretation of public principles. Use self-made, synthetic or explicitly licensed data only; do not operate real victim hosts, other accounts, industrial control or supercomputing facilities. Values are not product specifications or measured performance. Completion is not a qualification, real-equipment experience or production-deployment certification.

workedExample.title: 含假設的可重算工程例
workedExample.text: 歷史 Summit 計算節點有 6 個 V100 GPU；假想每 GPU 一份 12 GiB 工作集，總為 72 GiB，但分散的裝置記憶體不能自動成為單一連續 72 GiB 陣列。若每輪主機裝置搬移 1 GB、50 GB/s 假想持續速率，單向下限 20 ms。
workedExample.textEn: A historical Summit compute node has six V100 GPUs. Six assumed 12-GiB worksets total 72 GiB but do not automatically form one contiguous array. One assumed 1-GB transfer at sustained 50 GB/s has a 20-ms one-way lower bound.
workedExample.assumptions: 使用算例明列的單位、分佈、精度、拓撲與理想化條件；改變鄰接、位寬、取樣或系統邊界必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated units, distributions, precision, topology and idealizations; recompute after changing adjacency, width, sampling or boundaries.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者獨立設定的假想數值例，非引用機構的實測資料；來源支援領域定義與架構。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical values, not institutional measurements; sources support definitions and architecture.

courses.title: LUMI 超級電腦架構
courses.summary: 以LUMI 的 CPU/GPU 分割槽與高頻寬計算串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
courses.summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect lumi cpu/gpu partitions and high-bandwidth computing with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.

stages.title: 任務與分割槽
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「任務與分割槽」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop tasks and partitions through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 分割槽目的：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「分割槽目的」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for partition purposes.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「分割槽目的」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：LUMI-C 與 LUMI-G 對應不同處理資源。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「按玩具任務分出 CPU-only 與 GPU 部分。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for partition purposes. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: LUMI-C and LUMI-G serve different processing resources. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Split toy tasks into CPU-only and GPU parts. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 按玩具任務分出 CPU-only 與 GPU 部分。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Split toy tasks into CPU-only and GPU parts. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有分割槽都必須用 GPU。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Every partition requires GPUs. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「分割槽目的」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「按玩具任務分出 CPU-only 與 GPU 部分。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for partition purposes; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: LUMI-C 與 LUMI-G 對應不同處理資源。
knowledge.textEn: LUMI-C and LUMI-G serve different processing resources.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 按玩具任務分出 CPU-only 與 GPU 部分。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Split toy tasks into CPU-only and GPU parts. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 假想 4096³ 個 FP64 格點單陣列為 549755813888 bytes，即 512 GiB；若每邏輯 GPU 假想能分配 50 GiB，至少需 ceil(512/50)=11 個裝置，只算單陣列。halo、第二緩衝與庫工作空間將提高需求，不能當實際 LUMI 配額。
knowledge.textEn: A synthetic 4096-cubed FP64 array is 512 GiB. At assumed usable 50 GiB/logical GPU it needs at least 11 devices for one array only. Halos, extra buffers and library workspaces add capacity; this is not a LUMI quota.

quiz.question: 審查「分割槽目的」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for partition purposes?
options: 所有分割槽都必須用 GPU。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「分割槽目的」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
LUMI-C 與 LUMI-G 對應不同處理資源。
optionsEn: Every partition requires GPUs.
One matching output proves partition purposes for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
LUMI-C and LUMI-G serve different processing resources.
quiz.explanation: LUMI-C 與 LUMI-G 對應不同處理資源。 按玩具任務分出 CPU-only 與 GPU 部分。 因此「所有分割槽都必須用 GPU。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: LUMI-C and LUMI-G serve different processing resources. Split toy tasks into CPU-only and GPU parts. The alternative "Every partition requires GPUs." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 分割槽目的：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「分割槽目的」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for partition purposes.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「按玩具任務分出 CPU-only 與 GPU 部分。」；將結果與「LUMI-C 與 LUMI-G 對應不同處理資源。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Split toy tasks into CPU-only and GPU parts. Compare results against: LUMI-C and LUMI-G serve different processing resources. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 按玩具任務分出 CPU-only 與 GPU 部分。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Split toy tasks into CPU-only and GPU parts. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有分割槽都必須用 GPU。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Every partition requires GPUs. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「分割槽目的」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「所有分割槽都必須用 GPU。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for partition purposes; explain why this claim fails: Every partition requires GPUs.

State an observable prediction before planning this check: Map threads and data on a toy CPU node. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.title: Slingshot 網路：原理與架構

quiz.question: 審查「繫結親和」的驗證方法時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which validation approach is justified for binding affinity?

先把「繫結親和」的顯示結果調到符合預期，再把這次吻合當作獨立驗證。
畫玩具 rank 到資源的對映。

Tune the displayed binding affinity result to the expected value and count that agreement as independent validation.
Map toy ranks to resources.

steps.title: 集體通訊：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「集體通訊」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for collective communication.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「集體通訊」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：規約成本依拓撲、訊息大小與參加數。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「比較玩具小訊息與大訊息規約。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for collective communication. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Reduction costs depend on topology, sizes and participants. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare small- and large-message toy reductions. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 比較玩具小訊息與大訊息規約。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Compare small- and large-message toy reductions. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：每種訊息都有相同最佳規約演算法。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Every message shares the best reduction algorithm. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「集體通訊」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「比較玩具小訊息與大訊息規約。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for collective communication; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

quiz.question: 審查「集體通訊」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for collective communication?
options: 規約成本依拓撲、訊息大小與參加數。
每種訊息都有相同最佳規約演算法。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「集體通訊」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: Reduction costs depend on topology, sizes and participants.
Every message shares the best reduction algorithm.
One matching output proves collective communication for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
quiz.explanation: 規約成本依拓撲、訊息大小與參加數。 比較玩具小訊息與大訊息規約。 因此「每種訊息都有相同最佳規約演算法。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。

steps.title: 集體通訊：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「集體通訊」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for collective communication.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「比較玩具小訊息與大訊息規約。」；將結果與「規約成本依拓撲、訊息大小與參加數。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Compare small- and large-message toy reductions. Compare results against: Reduction costs depend on topology, sizes and participants. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 比較玩具小訊息與大訊息規約。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Compare small- and large-message toy reductions. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：每種訊息都有相同最佳規約演算法。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Every message shares the best reduction algorithm. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「集體通訊」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「每種訊息都有相同最佳規約演算法。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for collective communication; explain why this claim fails: Every message shares the best reduction algorithm.

steps.objective: 以「利用率判斷」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for utilization judgments.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「利用率判斷」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：GPU 忙碌時間不等於科學計算效率。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「對玩具忙等待與有效計算分別計量。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。

Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: GPU busy time is not scientific efficiency. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Account separately for toy busy-waiting and useful compute. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「異質節點」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：Aurora 計算節點結合兩 Xeon Max 與六 GPU Max。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「重畫自己的 CPU/GPU 功能框架。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for heterogeneous nodes. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Aurora combines two Xeon Max CPUs with six GPU Max devices per compute node. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Draw original CPU/GPU functional blocks. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 重畫自己的 CPU/GPU 功能框架。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Draw original CPU/GPU functional blocks. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Aurora contains GPUs without CPUs. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「異質節點」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「重畫自己的 CPU/GPU 功能框架。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for heterogeneous nodes; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: Aurora 計算節點結合兩 Xeon Max 與六 GPU Max。
knowledge.textEn: Aurora combines two Xeon Max CPUs with six GPU Max devices per compute node.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 重畫自己的 CPU/GPU 功能框架。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Draw original CPU/GPU functional blocks. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 公開架構有每節點 6 GPU；假想 1024³ FP64 陣列為 8 GiB，若每 GPU 存同樣輸入加兩個輸出共 24 GiB，則六份複製需 144 GiB，分佈分塊未必需六份輸入。例子是容量模型，非 Aurora 實際應用。
knowledge.textEn: Public architecture has six GPUs per node. A synthetic 1024-cubed FP64 array is 8 GiB; input plus two output arrays uses 24 GiB/GPU, or 144 GiB for six replicas. Partitioning may avoid replicated inputs; this is a capacity model, not an Aurora application.

quiz.question: 審查「異質節點」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for heterogeneous nodes?
options: Aurora 計算節點結合兩 Xeon Max 與六 GPU Max。
Aurora 是隻有 GPU 無 CPU 的系統。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「異質節點」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: Aurora combines two Xeon Max CPUs with six GPU Max devices per compute node.
Aurora contains GPUs without CPUs.
One matching output proves heterogeneous nodes for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
quiz.explanation: Aurora 計算節點結合兩 Xeon Max 與六 GPU Max。 重畫自己的 CPU/GPU 功能框架。 因此「Aurora 是隻有 GPU 無 CPU 的系統。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Aurora combines two Xeon Max CPUs with six GPU Max devices per compute node. Draw original CPU/GPU functional blocks. The alternative "Aurora contains GPUs without CPUs." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 異質節點：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「異質節點」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for heterogeneous nodes.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「重畫自己的 CPU/GPU 功能框架。」；將結果與「Aurora 計算節點結合兩 Xeon Max 與六 GPU Max。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Draw original CPU/GPU functional blocks. Compare results against: Aurora combines two Xeon Max CPUs with six GPU Max devices per compute node. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 重畫自己的 CPU/GPU 功能框架。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Draw original CPU/GPU functional blocks. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：Aurora 是隻有 GPU 無 CPU 的系統。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Aurora contains GPUs without CPUs. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「異質節點」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「Aurora 是隻有 GPU 無 CPU 的系統。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for heterogeneous nodes; explain why this claim fails: Aurora contains GPUs without CPUs.

knowledge.textEn: Ponte Vecchio tiles, slices and Xe cores form a hierarchy.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 按公開功能層次畫原創示意。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Draw an original functional hierarchy from public descriptions. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

quiz.question: 審查「GPU 層次」的驗證方法時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which validation approach is justified for gpu hierarchy?
options: 所有 GPU 單元都只叫一個不可分割核心。
先把「GPU 層次」的顯示結果調到符合預期，再把這次吻合當作獨立驗證。
按公開功能層次畫原創示意。
optionsEn: All GPU units form one indivisible core.
Tune the displayed gpu hierarchy result to the expected value and count that agreement as independent validation.
Draw an original functional hierarchy from public descriptions.
quiz.explanation: Ponte Vecchio 的 tile、slice 與 Xe core 有層次。 按公開功能層次畫原創示意。 因此「所有 GPU 單元都只叫一個不可分割核心。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Ponte Vecchio tiles, slices and Xe cores form a hierarchy. Draw an original functional hierarchy from public descriptions. The alternative "All GPU units form one indivisible core." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 向量與矩陣：原理與架構
steps.titleEn: Vectors and matrices: principles and architecture
steps.objective: 以「向量與矩陣」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for vectors and matrices.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「向量與矩陣」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：向量引擎與矩陣引擎適用不同運算。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「分類玩具 stencil 與 dense GEMM。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for vectors and matrices. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Vector and matrix engines suit different computations. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Classify toy stencils and dense GEMM. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 分類玩具 stencil 與 dense GEMM。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Classify toy stencils and dense GEMM. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：矩陣峰值就是任何向量運算吞吐。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Matrix peaks equal all vector throughput. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「向量與矩陣」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「分類玩具 stencil 與 dense GEMM。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for vectors and matrices; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 向量引擎與矩陣引擎適用不同運算。
knowledge.textEn: Vector and matrix engines suit different computations.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 分類玩具 stencil 與 dense GEMM。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Classify toy stencils and dense GEMM. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

quiz.question: 審查「向量與矩陣」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for vectors and matrices?
options: 向量引擎與矩陣引擎適用不同運算。
矩陣峰值就是任何向量運算吞吐。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「向量與矩陣」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: Vector and matrix engines suit different computations.
Matrix peaks equal all vector throughput.
One matching output proves vectors and matrices for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
quiz.explanation: 向量引擎與矩陣引擎適用不同運算。 分類玩具 stencil 與 dense GEMM。 因此「矩陣峰值就是任何向量運算吞吐。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Vector and matrix engines suit different computations. Classify toy stencils and dense GEMM. The alternative "Matrix peaks equal all vector throughput." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 向量與矩陣：實驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Vectors and matrices: experiments and evidence
steps.objective: 以「向量與矩陣」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for vectors and matrices.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「分類玩具 stencil 與 dense GEMM。」；將結果與「向量引擎與矩陣引擎適用不同運算。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Classify toy stencils and dense GEMM. Compare results against: Vector and matrix engines suit different computations. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 分類玩具 stencil 與 dense GEMM。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Classify toy stencils and dense GEMM. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：矩陣峰值就是任何向量運算吞吐。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Matrix peaks equal all vector throughput. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「向量與矩陣」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「矩陣峰值就是任何向量運算吞吐。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for vectors and matrices; explain why this claim fails: Matrix peaks equal all vector throughput.

stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「向量與矩陣」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop vectors and matrices through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 工作組資源：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「工作組資源」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for workgroup resources.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「工作組資源」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：暫存器與 shared local memory 約束併發。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「比較玩具 workgroup 的資源預算。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for workgroup resources. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Registers and shared local memory constrain concurrency. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare resource budgets for toy workgroups. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 比較玩具 workgroup 的資源預算。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Compare resource budgets for toy workgroups. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：workgroup 越大必然越快。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Larger workgroups are always faster. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「工作組資源」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「比較玩具 workgroup 的資源預算。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for workgroup resources; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for data residency. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Keeping data on devices avoids repeated host transfers. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare per-step and one-time transfers for toy PDEs. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Every array must return to the host each round. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「資料駐留」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「比較玩具多步 PDE 每步與一次傳送。」如何辨別它們。

Principle: Packet sharing and reserved circuits have different trade-offs. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare resource schedules for toy bursty users. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 比較玩具突發使用者的資源時間表。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。

steps.title: 分包重組：原理與架構
steps.titleEn: Segmentation and reassembly: principles and architecture

steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for segmentation and reassembly.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「分包重組」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：大訊息分包後需可辨順序與完整性。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「把自製短字串分三包再重排重組。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for segmentation and reassembly. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Segmented messages need ordering and completeness. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Split and reorder a self-made string into three packets. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 把自製短字串分三包再重排重組。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Split and reorder a self-made string into three packets. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Arrival order always equals send order. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「分包重組」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「把自製短字串分三包再重排重組。」如何辨別它們。

stages.title: 模擬與驗證

steps.title: 協議遷移：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「協議遷移」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for protocol migration.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「協議遷移」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：遷移需列相容、切換日期與回退問題。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「只在紙上製作玩具 NCP/TCP 遷移矩陣。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for protocol migration. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Transitions specify compatibility, dates and fallback issues. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Create a toy NCP/TCP transition matrix on paper. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.observationEn: Create a toy NCP/TCP transition matrix on paper. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.

steps.objective: 以「協議遷移」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for protocol migration.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「只在紙上製作玩具 NCP/TCP 遷移矩陣。」；將結果與「遷移需列相容、切換日期與回退問題。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。

steps.check: 提交「協議遷移」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「指定切換日期就自動解決所有相容問題。」為何不成立。

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 假想 20 kB HTML 加 3 張各40 kB 圖片總為 140 kB；在持續 100 kB/s 下資料傳輸下限1.4 s。若序列每物件另有0.1 s 等待，四物件總至少1.8 s，未含解析、DNS與重送；不代表首個 Web 伺服器。

Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Links make document relationships navigable addresses. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Draw links among three self-made pages. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

steps.observationEn: Draw links among three self-made pages. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.

steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for hypertext relationships; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for hypertext relationships.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「在自製三頁檔案畫有向連結圖。」；將結果與「連結把檔案關係變為可導航地址。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。

stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop links and transfer through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 地址與資源：原理與架構

steps.objective: 以「地址與資源」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。

Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Resource URLs, paths and stored files can differ. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare URLs and local paths for self-made pages. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 對自製頁面比較地址與本地路徑。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Compare URLs and local paths for self-made pages. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: URLs necessarily map to same-named disk files. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「地址與資源」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「對自製頁面比較地址與本地路徑。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for addresses and resources; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for multiple-object costs. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Page time includes multiple objects and request waits. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Recalculate the four-object example lower bound. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 重算本課四物件理想下限。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Recalculate the four-object example lower bound. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：HTML 大小就是整頁下載量。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。

steps.check: 提交「多物件成本」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「重算本課四物件理想下限。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for multiple-object costs; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 重算本課四物件理想下限。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。

quiz.question: 審查「多物件成本」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for multiple-object costs?
options: HTML 大小就是整頁下載量。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「多物件成本」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
頁面時間含多個物件與請求等待。
optionsEn: HTML size equals complete page traffic.
One matching output proves multiple-object costs for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
Page time includes multiple objects and request waits.
quiz.explanation: 頁面時間含多個物件與請求等待。 重算本課四物件理想下限。 因此「HTML 大小就是整頁下載量。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Page time includes multiple objects and request waits. Recalculate the four-object example lower bound. The alternative "HTML size equals complete page traffic." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 多物件成本：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「多物件成本」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。

steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「重算本課四物件理想下限。」；將結果與「頁面時間含多個物件與請求等待。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。

steps.title: 任務狀態：原理與架構

steps.title: 任務狀態：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「任務狀態」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。

steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「畫兩個玩具任務的狀態轉移。」；將結果與「執行、可執行與等待是不同狀態。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。

steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「畫玩具物件最後引用與回收。」；將結果與「引用、釋放與併發訪問需相容。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Draw last references and reclamation for a toy object. Compare results against: References, release and concurrent access must agree. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 畫玩具物件最後引用與回收。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Draw last references and reclamation for a toy object. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：物件不再顯示就一定無人正在讀取。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: An undisplayed object has no active readers. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「資源生命」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「物件不再顯示就一定無人正在讀取。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for resource lifetimes; explain why this claim fails: An undisplayed object has no active readers.

steps.title: 最小變更：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「最小變更」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for minimal changes.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「最小變更」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：獨立小變更利於評審與迴歸定位。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「將玩具多功能改動分成兩項可驗收變更。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。

Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Small independent changes improve review and regression attribution. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Split toy multifunction changes into two reviewable units. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 將玩具多功能改動分成兩項可驗收變更。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Split toy multifunction changes into two reviewable units. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：把全部改動揉在一起永遠更容易評審。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Combining every change always eases review. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「最小變更」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「將玩具多功能改動分成兩項可驗收變更。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for minimal changes; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

quiz.question: 審查「最小變更」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for minimal changes?
options: 把全部改動揉在一起永遠更容易評審。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「最小變更」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
獨立小變更利於評審與迴歸定位。
optionsEn: Combining every change always eases review.
One matching output proves minimal changes for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
Small independent changes improve review and regression attribution.

quiz.explanationEn: Small independent changes improve review and regression attribution. Split toy multifunction changes into two reviewable units. The alternative "Combining every change always eases review." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

一項測試透過就排除所有核心風險。

One passing test excludes every kernel risk.

quiz.explanation: 單元、整合與跨架構驗證覆蓋不同風險。 對玩具變更列需要的具體驗證。 因此「一項測試透過就排除所有核心風險。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Unit, integration and cross-architecture checks cover different risks. Specify concrete checks for a toy change. The alternative "One passing test excludes every kernel risk." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 測試層次：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「測試層次」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for test layers.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「對玩具變更列需要的具體驗證。」；將結果與「單元、整合與跨架構驗證覆蓋不同風險。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。

Exercise: Specify concrete checks for a toy change. Compare results against: Unit, integration and cross-architecture checks cover different risks. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 對玩具變更列需要的具體驗證。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。

steps.failure: 常見誤判：一項測試透過就排除所有核心風險。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。

steps.check: 提交「測試層次」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「一項測試透過就排除所有核心風險。」為何不成立。

steps.title: 評審證據：原理與架構

Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Performance and correctness claims map to benchmarks and limits. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Review input/version controls in a self-made report. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 審查自製報告是否控制輸入與版本。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。

steps.failure: 常見誤判：作者說變快就可不提供任何量測。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。

steps.check: 提交「評審證據」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「審查自製報告是否控制輸入與版本。」如何辨別它們。

courses.title: Internet 根網域伺服器系統

steps.objective: 以「名稱層次」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。

State an observable prediction before planning this check: Break down the hierarchy of self-made example.invalid. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Principle: Recursive resolvers follow delegations and cache for clients. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Draw client, recursive and authoritative roles. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

knowledge.textEn: NS and necessary glue help resolvers locate the next layer.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 以玩具區檔畫委派與 glue 的角色。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Draw delegation and glue roles in a toy zone. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

quiz.question: 審查「委派資料」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for delegation data?
options: NS 與必要 glue 幫助解析器找到下一層。
委派響應就是每個應用最終內容。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「委派資料」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: NS and necessary glue help resolvers locate the next layer.
Delegation responses contain final application content.
One matching output proves delegation data for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
quiz.explanation: NS 與必要 glue 幫助解析器找到下一層。 以玩具區檔畫委派與 glue 的角色。 因此「委派響應就是每個應用最終內容。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: NS and necessary glue help resolvers locate the next layer. Draw delegation and glue roles in a toy zone. The alternative "Delegation responses contain final application content." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 委派資料：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「委派資料」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for delegation data.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「以玩具區檔畫委派與 glue 的角色。」；將結果與「NS 與必要 glue 幫助解析器找到下一層。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Draw delegation and glue roles in a toy zone. Compare results against: NS and necessary glue help resolvers locate the next layer. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 以玩具區檔畫委派與 glue 的角色。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Draw delegation and glue roles in a toy zone. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：委派響應就是每個應用最終內容。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Delegation responses contain final application content. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「委派資料」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「委派響應就是每個應用最終內容。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for delegation data; explain why this claim fails: Delegation responses contain final application content.

steps.title: 權威邊界：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「權威邊界」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for authority boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「權威邊界」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：權威區與遞迴快取有不同資料責任。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「比較玩具權威更改與快取到期。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for authority boundaries. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Authoritative zones and recursive caches have different duties. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare toy authoritative changes and cache expiry. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 比較玩具權威更改與快取到期。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Compare toy authoritative changes and cache expiry. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：快取資料永遠等於權威最新資料。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Cached data always equals current authoritative data. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「權威邊界」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「比較玩具權威更改與快取到期。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for authority boundaries; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

steps.title: DNSSEC 信任：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「DNSSEC 信任」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。

Principle: Signatures authenticate provenance/integrity, not query secrecy. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Draw a toy trust chain without configuring real zones. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 畫玩具信任鏈而不設定真實區檔。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。

steps.objective: 以「韌性驗收」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for resilience acceptance.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「用玩具故障圖與快取表完成離線報告。」；將結果與「驗收要區分名稱正確、服務可用與隱私。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Complete an offline report from toy failures and caches. Compare results against: Acceptance separates correct names, availability and privacy. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 用玩具故障圖與快取表完成離線報告。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Complete an offline report from toy failures and caches. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：網頁能開一次就證明 DNS 永遠可靠。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: One successful page proves permanently reliable DNS. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「韌性驗收」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「網頁能開一次就證明 DNS 永遠可靠。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for resilience acceptance; explain why this claim fails: One successful page proves permanently reliable DNS.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 驗收要區分名稱正確、服務可用與隱私。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance separates correct names, availability and privacy.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 用玩具故障圖與快取表完成離線報告。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Complete an offline report from toy failures and caches. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 玩具 DNS 正向快取 TTL=300 s；每10秒一請求且無提前淘汰，300 s 內30個請求理想需1次上游查詢，命中29/30≈96.67%。TTL 不保證資料實時，重啟、負快取與不同解析器會改變此例。
knowledge.textEn: With toy TTL 300 s and one request every 10 s without early eviction, 30 requests ideally need one upstream query and yield 29/30≈96.67% hits. TTL is not real-time freshness; restarts, negative caching and resolver differences alter the result.

quiz.question: 審查「韌性驗收」的驗證方法時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which validation approach is justified for resilience acceptance?
options: 網頁能開一次就證明 DNS 永遠可靠。
先把「韌性驗收」的顯示結果調到符合預期，再把這次吻合當作獨立驗證。
用玩具故障圖與快取表完成離線報告。
optionsEn: One successful page proves permanently reliable DNS.
Tune the displayed resilience acceptance result to the expected value and count that agreement as independent validation.
Complete an offline report from toy failures and caches.
quiz.explanation: 驗收要區分名稱正確、服務可用與隱私。 用玩具故障圖與快取表完成離線報告。 因此「網頁能開一次就證明 DNS 永遠可靠。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Acceptance separates correct names, availability and privacy. Complete an offline report from toy failures and caches. The alternative "One successful page proves permanently reliable DNS." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.
